The progress of artificial intelligence has gone beyond our control.

I nodded in agreement:

- You're right, most of us scientists are still immersed in illusions about the progress of science but not many think about the future consequences. Currently, some parents have begun to raise the issue of children's addiction to the Internet and video games; and some scientists also note the rapid development of artificial intelligence, but no one has found a reasonable solution to this situation. But you just said that you had this experience in the past, so what is the story?

Mr. Thomas thought silently, then calmly replied:

- Honestly, I don't want to say this. But in the past, I was very pleased to hear Venerable Thanh Nghiem say that as long as some people consciously do good deeds, even if they are small, they can create a positive influence and can bring about big changes. If a small butterfly can create a hurricane, then sharing my experiences over many lifetimes can also help many people understand the immutable laws of the universe, and maybe they will realize something to change. Before we discussed a lot about Reincarnation and Karma, but I haven't told you clearly why I care about this. On the occasion of today's conversation, I can share with you about my past lives.

I looked at Mr. Thomas in silence. He stopped for a moment as if to let me think. Although I was surprised, I still remained silent, not wanting to interrupt this friend's train of thought. Mr. Thomas was immersed in thought for a long time, then said:

- What I share below is just my experience through previous lives. Of course you can believe it or not, depending on your understanding.

In today's whirlwind scientific world, of course it is difficult for anyone to believe the strange things Mr. Thomas told me that day.

If I say it out loud, most people will think it's just imagination, so I have no intention of sharing the story I heard with anyone but just keeping it to myself.

I have seen a famous person like astronaut Edgar Mitchell promote the study of spiritual phenomena, the laws of the universe hidden in nature, the existence of alien creatures, the correlation between the universe and humans, but are also criticized by the media. How many people believe in stories about past lives or reincarnation?

* * *

When Mr. Nguyen Van Phuoc, founder of Tri Viet Creative Culture Company - First News discussed the spiritual knowledge in the books I have adapted and rewritten for many years about

Before, I accidentally mentioned that story, Mr. Phuoc suggested that I share this interesting story with Vietnamese readers through a book. At first, I was shy because I hadn't written about these topics in many years. I was planning to stop writing, including writing about technology-related topics. However, with encouragement and inspiration from Mr. Phuoc when he believed that the stories from these real characters would be able to help many people spiritually - I contacted Mr. Thomas to ask for advice on writing a book about his past life experiences. At first I thought Mr. Thomas might not approve, because his story was too special and personal. But surprisingly, he agreed, with the only condition that his real name and the people involved would not be revealed in these stories. He said: "You can write and share these things with your friends, but don't put my real name in them. I don't want to become a subject of public opinion."

I know that Mr. Thomas is a famous and successful businessman in the New York financial market. His associates, colleagues and friends are all famous figures in American society and the world today. Obviously, no one wants to become the subject of tabloids or gossip on social networking sites.

Over the past few years, I have flown to New York to meet Mr. Thomas many times to carefully record his strange past life stories. We talked to each other in a very urgent but intimate and natural way so that he could share in more depth and detail about his past life experiences. At first, we didn't go in any order because this wasn't an interview or a memoir. I recorded all the important details, then systematized the messages in his story. I also discussed continuously with him during the writing process, so that he could give comments and edit more carefully, according to what he wanted to convey.

After that, he suggested: "In my opinion, we should change a few details in it, rewrite it in chronological order, so that it can become a lively book, not just a continuous conversation between us. This is not a research document or a long interview with questions and answers. words". And he affirmed after a moment of contemplation: "This will be a special book!".

So I edited it in chronological order, through lifetimes, according to the flow of history, and wrote "literary" some details and stories to become an attractive book, conveying important messages, not just a collection of documents. I hope that after reading the book, you will agree with that, and if there are any mistakes, please forgive me.

And the following is Mr. Thomas's story.

tieu_de: Part One: Colorado - The Predestined Encounter
noi_dung:
PART ONE

COLORADO

THE DESTINY MEETING

That day, I - Thomas - was working when my wife, Angie, walked in with an advertisement in her hand:

- I just found a vacation home for sale in

Colorado. Looking at the pictures, it's exactly what you want. Do you want to go see?

I quickly glanced at the advertisement. It is indeed a very beautiful house, located on a hill overlooking a clear blue lake, surrounded by luxuriant trees, looking very peaceful. I have long intended to buy a vacation home in the mountains of Colorado, but I don't like crowded cities full of tourists like Vail or Colorado Spring and just want to find a quiet, secluded place close to nature. As the owner of a large, growing financial company, I need a quiet vacation home so I can relax when needed. I went to see many resorts everywhere, from New England, Maine, to Florida, Arizona, but there was no place I liked as much as Colorado with its majestic, towering Rocky Mountains.

I told Angie:

- I'm busy right now, just go see it first, if you see it then buy it.

I called Charles to bring the plane so we could go quickly. If necessary, invite Andrew or Connie to go with you for fun.

Charles is the family's butler. Andrew and Connie are a young couple. Even though they work under me, we still consider them as our children because we don't have children.

Angie joked:

- Without you, how can I decide? What if you buy it and it's not what you want?

I glanced at the advertisement with the numbers, then laughed:

- If you see it, then buy it. It's okay for such a price.

Angie also laughed because I rarely pay attention to all the family expenses. Owning a large company worth hundreds of millions of dollars, a few hundred thousand for a vacation home is not an amount I have to worry too much about.

As soon as Angie left the room, I immediately called Charles:

- Please call the pilot to take a private plane to take my family to Colorado. I think Angie has found a suitable house. If Angie sees it, immediately call Brian to let him know to complete the procedure.

Brian is the family's personal lawyer, very proficient in all tasks, including financial issues. Seeing Angie's attitude, I knew she was satisfied with the house. Once Angie likes it, there is no reason for me to refuse.

That afternoon, I received a phone call from Angie:

- Honey, the house is very beautiful, much more beautiful than I thought. I like it very much. Connie also said it was a great house. Fully furnished and carefully renovated. Around the house is very quiet. The nearest house is quite far away so we don't have to worry about anyone watching or disturbing us while resting. What do you think?

I laughed and jokingly asked:

- Can we afford such a good house?

Angie also laughed:

- I called Brian to arrange to buy this house. Maybe everything will be completed next week. When can I come see this house?

I looked at the work schedule notes on the table filled with meetings, then said:

- I'm very busy right now, but after the paperwork is completed, I'll go over there and take a look.

It was a late fall day, the weather was starting to get cold, but Angie kept urging me to see the vacation house I had just bought. I refused several times because I was busy with work. Many weeks ago, Angie and Connie flew over there to buy and display furniture for this house.

Angie said:

- So this year for Christmas I can invite my friends here for a few days. We don't need to go on vacation far away anymore. This house has six comfortable bedrooms, enough for Andrew and his wife, Brian and his wife, Charles and his wife, and Andy too.

These people have been my trusted employees for many years. Every year I invite them to go on vacation together, so we can both relax and discuss work for the following year.

That afternoon, I received a phone call from Andrew saying that the weekend meeting had been canceled because the client suddenly had to go away. Andrew advised:

- This is your chance to see the vacation home. Mrs. Angie has been waiting

for a long time. If you agree, I will call Charles to prepare a plane for you and your grandparents.

I thought and answered:

- No need, I will fly the plane myself. The pilot worked a lot last week, he also needs to rest.

The Cessna Citation was our private plane and I also had a pilot's license, so just a few hours later we were in Colorado. This time, because there was no staff to accompany me, I had to rent a car to drive. As soon as we departed, it snowed, causing traffic congestion. After nearly two hours, we left the main highway to enter the small road leading up the mountain. At that time, it was already dark. The higher you go, the thicker the snow falls, covering the road white. After walking some distance, the GPS navigation system could no longer support it, because the house was not on the main road.

Angie looked at the road and directed me to turn onto the small winding roads leading up the mountain. The farther we went, the more snow fell, filling the path so it was difficult to see. The car drove for a while then collapsed into a hollow on the side of the road. Even though I tried, the car still wouldn't budge.

Angie lamented:

- Knowing that, let's just go to the hotel and rest until morning. In this situation, we probably have to sleep overnight in the car.

I quickly put on a warm coat and got out of the car to orient myself, but the surroundings were dark and I couldn't see anything. I tried to use all my strength to push the car out of the crater, but to no avail.

While I was frustrated, I suddenly saw a light in the distance slowly approaching, then a tall man holding a flashlight walked over:

- You must have lost your way. I heard the engine roar so I went out to see. Do you need any help?

Angie happily answered:

- We just bought a house recently, the previous owner's name was Hart but now we can't find the entrance.

The strange man nodded:

- So that's it! I know Mr. Hart's house. You have lost your way. We should have turned left at the bend right at the edge of the forest, but we had gone too far.

Seeing my confused look next to the collapsed car, he continued:

- It's already dark and his car can't go. If you don't mind, please stop by my house and stay overnight tonight. Tomorrow I will bring an axle to pull it up. It's dark now and there's so much snow falling.

Before I could say anything, Angie happily accepted immediately. We carried our luggage and followed the man to a house hidden under snow-covered pine trees. The owner invited us into his house.

Under the light of the lamp, I realized that it was a person of Indian or Middle Eastern origin, with a very thick beard. For some reason, I thought he looked very familiar even though I couldn't remember where I had seen this person.

The owner politely led us into a private room:

- You can use that room, if you don't mind, please have dinner with me.

Angie innocently accepted immediately:

- Thank you, it's so precious, because we haven't had anything in our stomachs since this morning.

After finishing preparing, we entered the dining room and the owner was already waiting in front of the simple dining table full of fresh fruit. Angie looked around the large room with strange looking paintings:

- Are you alone?

The owner nodded slightly:

- Yes, I live alone.

We sat at the table. The owner spoke up:

- I'm sorry for not having time to prepare other dishes. Normally I only eat fruit...

Angie is agile:

- Thank you, that's good. I also like fruit more than other things.

I observed the owner, he had a very familiar look in my subconscious that I couldn't remember where I had seen him before. I have a very good memory, I can remember almost everyone's name. Having worked in the commercial field for many years, I have the habit of remembering the names of the people I interact with. While Angie and the owner chatted intimately, I tried to search my memory but couldn't remember. Suddenly the owner seemed to guess what I was thinking, turned to me and introduced himself:

- Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Ramakrishnan, but you can call me Kris for ease of memory.

We also introduced ourselves. Mr. Kris smiled and held up a glass of orange juice:

- It's a pleasure to meet you.

While we also held up a glass of orange juice as a social gesture, I saw that Mr. Kris had a scarab-shaped ring on his finger, encrusted with a dark red ruby. There was something about the ring that felt strangely familiar to me. I looked closely at this bearded man. He has very bright eyes that show a rich inner mind and understanding. His gestures were slow and calm but still exuded a strange majesty. I have met many heads of state, managers of large companies, and high-ranking leaders, but I have never seen anyone as elegant and majestic as this person.

Angie is an innocent, social person. She can talk to almost anyone she meets, while I like to ponder and speak quietly. My friends still say that we are a beautiful couple. If you need anything, Angie says it, but if you plan something, I'm the one who decides.

While Angie and the owner continued their conversation at the dining table, I looked around the house with paintings of strange zigzag symbols. Although I don't know much about art, I can still distinguish the schools of painting of contemporary artists like Picasso or Dali. However, these paintings are different from regular paintings, they have lines that look like calligraphy but are not calligraphy. In my company, there are also several calligraphy paintings of famous Japanese and Chinese masters that were given to me by the clients themselves. However, the paintings here have different lines than the other calligraphy paintings.

Seeing me paying attention to the painting, Mr. Kris smiled:

- How do you like these paintings? It seems you like art

art?

Before I could answer, Angie pointed to a picture and immediately said:

- I recognize it, those are Sanskrit words. That's the word "Om", right?

The owner nodded:

- That's right, it's a Sanskrit word, you're right. That word is “Om”.

Angie shouted with joy:

- I saw words like that hanging in the Yoga room.

The owner smiled:

- So you also practice Yoga.

Angie nodded:

- Every week I go to yoga with my friends. It is a form of

exercise to maintain health. In addition, I also practice meditation.

Not wanting the story to go too far, I asked:

- So it's a Sanskrit word, but why does the Yoga studio hang this word

? Why don't they hang other, more beautiful pictures?

Mr. Kris laughed:

- Maybe it's just a form of decoration. Yoga comes from India, so hanging Sanskrit words on it is also a form of advertising...

Angie shook her head:

- No, my Yoga teacher said that it is a very sacred word and when meditating you must focus your thoughts on it.

Mr. Kris nodded and said:

- That's it! So what do you see when you focus on that word?

Angie was confused:

- I don't see anything. That's just a method to keep your thoughts from running wild. However, my friend Connie said that she saw it emit light and sometimes appear different lines of text, but I have never had that experience.

I laughed because I knew Connie very well:

- Connie is an imaginative person and maybe exaggerates things...

Mr. Kris turned to look at me and said:

- Not really, if one meditates to a certain extent, one can

see strange lights or images.

Angie is curious:

- So you must know clearly about meditation or have you experienced it?

Mr. Kris did not answer but turned to ask me:

- What do you think?

I looked at the man's very bright eyes, with witty features. I answered:

- I have never practiced meditation or Yoga. It's just a popular form of exercise today, just like a few years ago there was the aerobics movement.

Mr. Kris looked at me with a mischievous look:

- So you have never practiced meditation?

Of course I feel uncomfortable:

- Of course, why do I practice those things?

Fortunately, Angie interjected:

- My husband is very busy, even playing sports he doesn't have time to practice yoga or meditation.

Mr. Kris pointed to a picture:

- So what do you think of this picture?

I looked at the picture, those were also strange symbols but they didn't look like Sanskrit letters. This symbol is completely different.

The more I looked, the more I saw something familiar and felt drawn to it. Suddenly I burst out and said without thinking:

- I find it familiar, I seem to have seen it somewhere. But it is not the same as Sanskrit.

Mr. Kris smiled with a strange expression:

- You are right, that is not Sanskrit, but an ancient language that has been lost for a long time. But how do you see it?

I looked at the strange zigzag lines but couldn't remember where I had seen them. Angie suddenly interjected:

- I also find it familiar. Seems like I've seen it somewhere

where.

Mr. Kris smiled mysteriously:

- Right now you don't remember, but you will remember.

Angie pointed to a nearby glass box:

- And that stick, I also think it looks familiar. What is that?

Only then did I see on the small table near the fireplace a long glass box, in which was placed a silver stick about six hands long. The owner walked to the box, took out the stick and gave it to me. It was a stick made of crystal-like material, silver in color, with seven thumb-sized gems, each of a different color. As soon as I picked it up, I immediately felt a strong electric current from the stick enter my hand, startling me. My voice trembled:

- What is that?

Mr. Kris gently touched the stick solemnly:

- It is an object with medicinal properties, if people know how to use it

.

I looked intently at the stick, the gems on the stick suddenly emitted strange lights that made my eyes dizzy. I tremblingly held the stick that the master had just given me. Then the gems suddenly rotated gently like wheels and emitted strange rays of light.

Angie spoke up:

- When it emitted light, I thought it was a flashlight, but now these stones rotate with strange colors. Mr. Kris, what is it?

The owner whispered in my ear:

- Don't you recognize it?

At that time I felt like I was sleepwalking. I held the stick tightly but my mind was indescribably confused. I asked myself:

- Why am I here? Why did I meet a stranger in a house with strange objects like this?

At that moment, I felt a stream of power from the stick enter my body, causing my whole body to heat up. My chest was tight, my mind became confused, I could no longer control myself. I wanted to let go of the stick, but it had a strange attraction that made me unable to put it down. My ears heard the murmur of ocean waves and other strange sounds.

I tried to stay calm, turned to Angie, I saw her still standing still. I turned back to the owner but saw nothing but his bright eyes looking straight at me. He said in a friendly voice:

- Just calm down, friend. Let your subconscious work, and you will

understand.

My mind became hazy. The sound of the ocean waves became louder and louder and I clearly heard strange noises even though I couldn't distinguish what they were. Everything gradually became confused and spinning in my head. Suddenly, I felt a force pounding into my chest, causing me to fall asleep...

tieu_de: Part Two: Atlantis - Past Lives Awaken
noi_dung:
PART TWO

Atlantis

WAVES IN THE PREVIOUS LIFE

I found myself standing in front of a deserted beach with the sound of waves crashing, nearby were machines making strange sounds that I didn't know what they were for. For some reason, I felt filled with a feeling of sadness and discomfort. As soon as I looked down, I was startled to see that my feet were bigger than before. At that moment, I realized that I was in another body.

I rubbed my eyes, waved my hand vigorously to wake myself up and thought to myself: "Is this a dream?". But I don't dream at all. As soon as my hand swung up, it touched an object hanging on my hip. I picked it up to see that it was the crystal stick with seven gems embedded in it that I had just seen at the stranger's house. I tried to stay calm but my mind kept spinning, then the images in my head appeared one after another like a slow motion movie.

I found myself living on a large continent surrounded by many small islands. Somehow I knew that it was Atlantis. Greek legend says that Atlantis existed in ancient times, in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, is considered the cradle of Egyptian and Greek civilization, and is very influential on current civilization.

However, even then I also knew that the Atlantis civilization had progressed much further than today's civilization because it was built on knowledge that was completely different from today's. Since ancient times, the Atlanteans have developed a special type of knowledge that helps them use the potential powers in nature and create a science and technology that is completely different from today. My mind became confused, images of a strange memory kept coming from somewhere.

At that time, the Atlanteans created advanced tools and machines for purposes that cannot be explained today. The reason I felt uncomfortable was because I was entering another body, with different feelings and knowledge. As a strong-willed person, I can recognize the big difference between the way I think and feel now and the way I am in modern times. My reasoning mind plays a very small and weak role in this body. After a moment of hopeless struggle between two contrasting understandings, I let my subconscious take control, bringing me back to the past, like a person observing a film of the past.

I am clearly seeing historical images of Atlantis gradually appearing in my mind. Since ancient times, the Atlanteans have developed a science that focuses on using the powers hidden in nature. They can use sunlight and the vibrations of metals [2] to change the atoms of matter. They can lose the weight of an object to build giant, solid structures without using modern machinery like today. They could change atoms in the human body to serve healing using gem-studded sticks.

At that time, Atlantis consisted of three countries: Og, Poseida and Arya. The Land of Og is located in the western part of the Atlantic Ocean, consisting of three islands connected by great stone bridges. Poseida is located in the East of the Atlantic Ocean, consisting of a large island with many small islands surrounding it. Arya is located in the North of the Atlantic Ocean, built on a plateau of a volcanic mountain.

The Atlantis civilization lasted thousands of years with many dynasties and kings. Atlantis society was divided into many different castes. High-caste people brutally and brutally oppress and exploit low-caste people. The culture of this country advocates "the strong win, the weak lose" but has not developed a law or justice system like today's society. At that time, except for a minority who had developed the ability to reason through reason, the majority of Atlanteans still lived by instinct, so they were very selfish, greedy and violent.

Because sex is a natural instinct, the people of this land did not know how to control their sexuality. Sexual intercourse between men and women is normal in society and no law prohibits or controls it. My memories became even more confused when I saw scenes of human intercourse at that time that were not much different from animals today. In that society, sexual intercourse between men and women takes place everywhere, without distinction, not based on emotions but only based on instinct and strength.

It's difficult to explain this because every time I try to reason, my mind is invaded by strange thoughts, causing an indescribable pain in my head. I know that the civilization of this country has advanced scientifically, much better than today, but I don't understand how the Atlantean society could live barbarically with such strange customs? Perhaps because they did not know how to develop love or reason, most Atlanteans at that time lived selfishly, greedily and ferociously. Throughout the history of this country, wars between countries occurred continuously, seemingly never stopping.

The Atlantis civilization was built on scientific knowledge, a science that is completely different from today. People with specialized abilities were especially favored, so scientific subjects developed very strongly, with discoveries that today can be considered "miracles".

Based on the vibrations of metal and sound, the Atlanteans can analyze sunlight into energy to serve life as well as create deadly weapons.

They can replace the human brain with tools attached to the brain, making these people stupid, ignorant and under the influence of others.

Through the technique of losing material weight to lift giant rocks or heavy objects high, the Atlanteans were able to build extremely great architectural works. Thanks to that, Atlantis developed with tens of thousands of buildings, hundreds of giant pyramids, thousands of houses close together, with wide roads and great stone bridges connecting small islands together.

Through the technique of changing atoms, the Atlanteans can change weak and damaged organs in the human body to cure diseases. This method can also transform humans into another creature by transplanting their internal organs with animal organs and creating a new type of human. A type of "half-human, half-animal" creature, a human-like creature, with special abilities to use for purposes that people today cannot imagine.

Some people, mostly low-caste people, or prisoners of war are often brought into the laboratory to cooperate with the atoms of powerful animals such as buffaloes, cows, elephants, horses, and camels, and then they are entrusted with heavy work such as construction and transportation. It is a workforce that no longer knows how to think but only follows orders.

Human beings combined with the atoms of ferocious animals (such as lions, tigers, leopards, wolves, etc.) are entrusted with the task of controlling low-caste people or those who have been transformed to become "half-human, half-animal" creatures, serving the interests of the higher caste. These are extremely fierce soldiers, ready to commit evil, completely emotionless, regardless of the suffering of other creatures.

Because of their ferocious army, the ambitious leaders of Atlantis often fought with each other to expand their power and fierce bloody battles occurred regularly between these lands.

The land of Og is the center of a religion that worships many gods with strange rituals, stemming from the influence of creatures belonging to a world other than humans. This is also the place where low-class people or prisoners of war are often killed as sacrifices, or sent to "human smelting furnaces" to turn into a labor force.

The Belia dynasty of Og lasted for hundreds of years with emperors who had ambitions to expand religious power by waging war with other lands. Because faith is built on a religion that worships many demons and gods from distant realms, always requiring sacrifices with flesh and blood, the people of Og are accustomed to living in violence, selfishness, indifference and hatred. The society of Og is full of disputes and hatred between people due to the policy of "the strong win, the weak lose". This is also the place where humans live intermingled, have sex with "half-human, half-animal" species and produce a strange breed of "monsters" called "Belia's children". Because of the disputes and hatred that always existed between the people of this land, the emperors of the Belia dynasty plotted to build hatred with other countries, in order to turn hatred among the people into wars, avoiding society from entering a state of chaos or civil war.

Of the three lands of Atlantis, Poseida is the largest and most prosperous, with abundant resources and powerful soldiers. Poseida consists of a number of small islands surrounding a large island with immense forests and strange animals. Because of its fertile land and many natural resources, social life in this country is more developed than in other countries.

The Poseida people also worship many gods such as sea gods, river gods, mountain gods, tree gods, etc. but do not have rituals of killing and sacrificing people like the religion of Og.

Poseida's science has developed very strongly with many innovations and state-of-the-art machinery. The people of Poseida enjoy a life of complete material comfort, but because of that, the majority live lavishly, wastefully, selfishly, and are highly lustful. They often kidnap women from other countries and bring them back to serve their fleshly needs. This created a huge feud between Poseida and the other lands. In the history of Atlantis, Og ​​and Poseida always fought with each other, but Poseida usually won. Through his victories, Poseida captured many "half-human, half-animal" prisoners and turned these people into slaves to serve the people here. This makes the hatred between these two countries even deeper.

Arya is the smallest country in the North, built on the plateau of a mountain, sparsely populated. Although the conditions were harsh and the land difficult to cultivate, Aryan society developed in a completely different way from the other two countries. The culture of this country is based on a religion that worships the sun with extremely strict dogmas and disciplines, such as not allowing humans to have sex with "half-human, half-animal" species. Therefore, the Aryans often boast that they are the purest Atlantean people.

Aryan science was built on knowledge of sunlight and the vibrations of metals. Long ago, the Aryans created jade sticks that could change the atoms of matter to cure diseases, as well as weapons that used light to destroy matter. Thanks to that, Arya maintained her independence for a long time.

It's hard to imagine the history of Atlantis appearing clearly in my subconscious like a vivid picture. My mind continued to cycle through strange events.

I feel like I was born in the land of Arya into a noble family, belonging to the highest class in society. My father is the head of the medical school, specializing in using jade sticks to treat diseases. Since childhood, I have been taught about the natural powers hidden in gemstones. When I grew up, I was trained by famous masters so I became a talented physician in the country.

As a person of high class and respected by society, I became arrogant and unusually ambitious. Even though I had been trained in medicine, I was not satisfied and wanted to gain more knowledge about the supernatural powers that were only privately transmitted to the priests in the Sun temple.

I once asked my father about this, but he said:

- There is a very clear line between the understanding that we can use

Current uses and understanding are based on knowledge over which we have no control. To research supernatural powers, people need to have internal control. Except for a very few priests in the Sun Temple who know this method, almost no one can learn it. If you cannot control yourself and use these abilities irresponsibly, it can lead to extremely harmful consequences. That is why you must be clearly aware of the potential dangers of this knowledge and not use what you cannot control.

I wonder:

- Why do only the priests in the Sun temple have the privilege of acquiring knowledge about supernatural powers?

My father replied:

- You should know, in every person there are two contrasting motivations: one is upward - the other is downward. When people do not yet know how to develop reasoning to control the mind and only live by instinct, lower instinctual motivation often dominates. It leads people to act according to desire. You can see that the people of Og and Poseida tend to live by instinct and the result is long, unending wars.

Currently, in Arya, there are only priests in the Sun temple, who, thanks to practicing self-discipline and knowing how to develop their reasoning mind to control their inner thoughts, are not affected. Thanks to knowing how to control their desires, these people can use special supernatural powers in the universe. People like us are only taught a limited amount of knowledge because our hearts are still a battlefield, a struggle between two contrasting tendencies. Therefore, if you cannot control yourself, you must know how to limit yourself and not let ambition dominate or control you.

Even though I have been warned, I still secretly want to possess power from those supernatural abilities. I once asked a priest who had knowledge about this subject and he said:

- Currently, your mind is not developed enough in terms of reasoning ability and is often controlled by instinct. If you want to possess supernatural powers, you must go through stages of practice to develop the virtues of sacrifice and patience, to control yourself.

I asked:

- So what should I do?

The priest replied:

- First of all, you must learn to sacrifice to do things that are "contrary"

to what people usually do. If people desire something, you must go against it, that is, give up that desire. If everyone only does what benefits themselves, then you must do the opposite, that is, only do what benefits others.

You must give your best to others, do what no one else wants to do, and only receive what no one else wants to receive. That is the first step in practicing the discipline of sacrifice, patience, and inner control. Can you do that?

The Atlantis civilization at that time was completely built on the "law of the strong", no one knew anything about sacrifice or the spirit of self-control. Most people live greedy, selfish and violent lives, ready to appropriate everything for themselves, so practicing what the priest said is extremely strange and difficult to understand.

As an arrogant and selfish person, of course I refused to listen to this priest's teachings. However, because I wanted this power, I had to be determined to get it. I calculated and found people who possessed this knowledge through a shortcut.

First, I got acquainted with Biru, an Aryan citizen who had lived for many years in Og, so he knew the rituals to call on powers from other realms. I was instructed by him in those rituals, even though the laws and religion of Arya completely prohibited this.

We secretly exchanged understanding with each other in a bunker deep underground. From then on, I immersed myself in sacrificial rituals, using blood to call upon strange forces, and communicating with creatures of other realms without any awareness of the possible consequences.

While absorbed in these images, my mind suddenly switched to another memory. I found myself standing in a huge, magnificent building, with exquisite carvings, far superior to the most beautiful architectural works of today. It is a solemn temple of the Sun god, with religious rituals performed by female saints. Suddenly, I saw the sexy, white bare feet of a holy woman briefly exposed while gracefully dancing and singing to mysterious music in the fanciful flickering torchlight. I secretly asked and found out her name was Kor. For some reason, the image of this holy woman Kor immediately invaded and dominated my mind, making me no longer able to control myself. Without taking my eyes off the lovely young woman, my mind began to heat up with the idea of ​​appropriating the saint. As a person of a high social class, once I want to own something, I often have to find every way to appropriate it until I can get it.

Just thinking about that, for some reason my mind began to be disturbed by flickering images of ghosts, strange mystical worship rituals, animals killed to sacrifice to the gods, glasses of wine mixed with fishy animal blood, images of joy of crowds of men and women letting loose under the flickering torchlight of wild, wild forests. Suddenly I saw horrifying scenes of blood and flesh, with fierce battles of "half-human, half-animal" soldiers tearing apart their victims. My fear increased day by day, causing me to scream loudly in panic, then suddenly woke up.

* * *

Any action, word or thought we have is a cause and sometimes it bears fruit right now, but sometimes it is latent and bears fruit at another time. We are the creators of our destiny. No one can really do anything for us. All of us in every moment have the opportunity to sow or create causes for ourselves. Good or bad causes are created by us, and when they bear fruit depends on many other factors.

Mr. Kris paused and concluded:

- Today we discussed the path of action - Karma Yoga, an ancient wisdom that very few people know about today. I want to emphasize that it is the wisdom of the universe, not just India's, although today people still think it comes from India.

In fact, universal law covers everywhere and governs all things. It is not specific to any one place or locality. Since ancient times, there have been civilizations with sages who have learned, studied and researched about these things. Those who were taught from this wisdom went everywhere to teach people. Depending on where they come from, depending on local conditions and customs, the teaching method also changes somewhat, but wisdom or universal law never changes.

Unfortunately, today people only talk about methods, not many people mention philosophy. Therefore, for most people, Yoga is just a method of physical practice and meditation is just a method of calming the mind to relax the mind.

* * *

When we discussed the topic of Karma Yoga, Mr. Thomas said that the important lesson he had personally learned through his lives was to develop love. It was an unexpected thought that arose during his life in Atlantis, although at that time the people of this land did not know anything about love. For some reason, he regretted and had thoughts of loving Kor in the last moments of that life.

It became a very strong driving force that led him in future lives to learn and develop love.

Mr. Thomas said that the talk with Mr. Kris about Karma Yoga also helped him and his wife understand more about universal laws such as Reincarnation and Cause and Effect. Although he had learned about these things in previous lives, he was still not clearly aware of them.

He revealed that in the current cycle, these two laws are important lessons that everyone must learn to know about the workings in the universe and the consequences they cause. He concluded: “Never do anything without considering its consequences” .

tieu_de: Part Four: Egypt - The Divine Not in Monuments
noi_dung:
PART FOUR

EGYPT

THE SPIRITS ARE NOT IN THE STATUE

THE FOUR

After a short trip in Colorado, we returned to New York to continue our daily work. The strange meeting with Mr. Kris and the memory of Atlantis made me start thinking about the concept of Reincarnation and Karma.

Up to now, I have been a practical person, not believing in anything crazy, but now I am completely influenced by what Mr. Kris said. Has everyone gone through many lifetimes to learn? But what has humanity done, what has it learned or not learned? What causes have they created and what results will they reap? Do the people we meet in this life have a previous relationship? Why don't many people remember their past lives? If past actions govern present circumstances and present actions will govern the future, what will the future of humanity be like? In the past, I never worried about the meaning of life, but now it is a question that is making me think a lot.

One day, while I was working, Angie walked in:

- Connie and I just went to see the exhibition about Egypt at the New York museum. Since listening to Mr. Kris speak, I have noticed and noticed that the jewelry of Egyptian kings all had gems like that. The mausoleums are also painted with the colors of jade. If gems are beneficial for health, I also want to buy a bracelet with seven gems like that. What do you think? Do you want to go shopping with me?

I'm someone who really doesn't like shopping. Angie took care of all the necessary items, from clothes, shoes to everything else, but for some reason I accepted that day. Diamond District (Diamond District) is located on Street 47 and Street 5 and is home to many jewelry stores. There are all kinds of goods here, from gold, silver, diamonds, to precious gems, all kinds of things, large and small.

Almost every tourist who comes to New York must visit this area.

We visited famous stores such as Tiffany, Bvlgari, Cartier, Van Cleef, etc. Wherever Angie was, she happily talked to the sales staff and offered to see bracelets with precious gems. Because they know us, every shop owner invites my wife and I into a private room reserved only for distinguished guests and brings out special and rare jewelry for us to choose from.

While Angie looked at the bracelets, I idly looked around and saw a picture of a scarab ring with rubies on the wall. I immediately recognized it as the ring that Mr. Kris often wears.

I asked the seller:

- What ring is that?

The seller replied:

- That is the ring of the ancient Pharaohs.

I asked further:

- Can I see that ring?

The customer laughed:

- That's just a decorative photo, this ring is an antique currently displayed in a museum in London.

For some reason, I feel that ring is extremely familiar.

I then suggested:

- Can you make a ring like that?

The seller was surprised:

- It's an ancient ring, but nowadays no one wears rings like that

anymore.

Seeing me staring at that ring, Angie immediately said:

- If I order a ring exactly like that, can you guys make it?

The salesperson replied:

- Our company can make any type of jewelry you want. However, this is a special case so we must contact the jeweler to get an opinion.

Angie nodded:

- This is our address. I want to order a ring exactly like the picture. Please contact the jeweler and let me know the price and time.

Leaving the store, Angie curiously asked:

- Do you like that ring very much? But you never wear a ring?

I nodded:

- For some reason, I felt like I liked it right from the moment I saw it.

Angie happily said:

- Great, so I bought you your favorite food, but you have never paid attention to these things before.

However, when I got back to the office, I was so busy that I completely forgot to go shopping with Angie. About three weeks later, while I was at work, the secretary came in and said there was a jeweler who wanted to see me. It was a small old Jewish man wearing thick glasses. He introduced himself:

- I am a jeweler specializing in ancient Egyptian, Persian

and Indian jewelry. I heard he wanted an Egyptian-style scarab ring. I was sent by the company to work with him.

Before measuring his finger to make a ring, the old man asked:

- Which finger do you want to wear this ring on?

For some reason, I answered immediately without thinking:

- I want to wear it on my index finger.

The old man was startled:

- Why is it the index finger? People only wear rings on the middle finger or ring finger, usually called the ring finger. Only ancient Pharaohs wore rings on their index fingers.

The old man pondered, then spoke:

- The ring on the index finger symbolizes the authority of the Pharaoh. Once Pharaoh gives an order with his index finger wearing a ring, it is the highest authority and everyone must absolutely obey.

I was extremely surprised:

- How do you know those things?

The old man laughed:

- I am a jeweler specializing in ancient jewelry. Of course, I had to research to understand the types of jewelry as well as the meaning of their origin. This is the type of ring of the Egyptian Pharaohs, in the past it was considered the royal seal of the court. Although the outside of the ring is the same, each Pharaoh has inscriptions engraved on it depending on their wishes. If not a highly specialized craftsman, not many people would know this.

I curiously asked:

- So whose ring is on display at the London museum? And what words are engraved on it?

The old man smiled:

- It is the ring of a Pharaoh belonging to the last era of the Egyptian kings' dynasty, before Egypt was invaded by the Assyrians around six hundred and fifty years BC. That ring was engraved with the words “May the Sun God Amun Ra [3] protect me.” Inside there is an image of the falcon Horus, symbolizing justice.

I was surprised by the jeweler's knowledge:

- What else do you know about that ring?

The old Jewish man continued:

- That ring is encrusted with a ruby. Rubies symbolize faith, so I think this Pharaoh must be a person with strong religious faith. Every time they ascended the throne, the Pharaohs had priests perform a special ritual of infusing spells into jewelry to protect them. Currently, this ring is displayed in a museum in London, so there is nothing dangerous.

I asked in surprise:

- Why is it dangerous?

The old man replied:

- When the Pharaoh died, his belongings and jewelry were buried with them.

So these mausoleums are often dug up and excavated by thieves to get precious items. Many antique collectors buy these without knowing their dangers. Most of the objects buried with the kings were enchanted for protection, or the mummies were kept by priests who kept some underworld creatures to protect the graves. Therefore, antique buyers are often harmed by these invisible motivations and energies. If they didn't die, the family would be ruined and their descendants would have difficulty living in peace.

Of course, today no one believes in such things. Some people think that these are just myths intended to scare people and prevent them from going to those burial places. However, you probably know that many archaeologists have died unexpectedly. Some millionaires who like to collect antiques of ancient kings also encountered unexpected tragic accidents.

The old Jewish man saw my doubtful expression so he continued:

- You probably know about the tomb of Pharaoh Tutankhamun or

“King Tut”. This is a tomb that has existed for thousands of years, intact, and not stolen. In 1923, archaeologists Howard Carter and Lord Carnarvon discovered this tomb. After digging the grave, Lord Carnarvon died unexpectedly for a very vague reason.

His assistant in digging the grave, George Gould, also died of an accident a few days later. Of the forty people present at the exhumation of "King Tut's" tomb, twenty-five also died within three months. Many people believe that the tomb was sprayed with poison, but so far no one has found any evidence that there was poison in the tomb.

I laughed:

- Is that just a rumor exaggerated by the press?

The jeweler shook his head:

- We have been doing this job for a long time so we know everything better than others. For us, antiques and jewelry taken from graves and places of worship are taboo, no one dares to touch them.

Seeing me still shaking my head in disbelief, the old man continued:

- One of the famous jewelry is the blue "Hope" diamond (Hope) kept in the Smithsonian museum in Washington D.C. It originates from a very large diamond embedded in the forehead of a deity in an ancient temple in India. During the civil war between the emirs, a rebel commander took down the diamond to sell. Just a few days later, he died unexpectedly, and the diamond was secretly brought back to Europe by a French jewelry merchant named Jean Tavernier.

According to documents, Tavernier sold this diamond to the French court to attach to the crown of King Louis the Fourteenth and was called the green pearl of France (Le Bleu de France). Shortly after selling this diamond, Tavernier bled to death in his jewelry factory in Paris. After wearing the crown during the coronation ceremony, King Louis the Fourteenth also fell ill, his flesh rotted and died of poisoning. Not only that, this king's children also died tragically. Some drowned, some died from fire, some died from falling from horses while hunting, only one person survived.

The crown passed through the hands of King Louis the sixteenth. This man had the diamond removed to make a necklace for Queen Marie Antoinette. You probably know that just a few years later, both died tragically on the guillotine during the French Revolution of 1792. The royal property was divided among the leaders of the revolution. According to documents from jewelers at that time, the diamond was brought to England and fell into the hands of a famous jeweler, Wilhelm Fals. The document clearly states that he cut it into four smaller diamonds to make it easier to sell because few people can afford to buy a diamond weighing hundreds of carats like that. Shortly after, Wilhelm Fals was killed by his own son to steal his fortune. The son was convicted and also died in prison. What happened to these four diamonds was not mentioned by anyone for a long time.

According to the jewelers' documents, the young American millionaire Somerset bought one - called the "Hope" diamond , which means hope (but the consequences for those who own it are the opposite, very tragic) as a gift for his fiancée - at that time a shimmering aristocratic diamond. This is known as "The Heart of the Ocean" . The couple enjoyed a stormy honeymoon on the fateful ship Titanic. You probably know what happened to the Titanic.

The second stone fell into the hands of Tsar Nicholas and was made into a jade necklace worn around the neck of Queen Alexandria. Then you probably know what happened to the Russian Tsar's family during the Bolshevik Revolution of 1917. Now I don't know whose hands that pearl necklace belongs to.

The third pill fell into the hands of Greek millionaire Simon Maoncharides. Just a short time after buying the diamond, this man drove his car and fell down a cliff to a tragic death. Currently, no one knows who this diamond belongs to? Some say it fell into the hands of millionaire Onassis and was given to Jacqueline Kennedy during her wedding. If this diamond was kept in the Kennedy family, it would be unfortunate. You probably know what happened to this family. However, this is just a rumor, no one knows the truth.

The fourth, largest and most beautiful pill is sold in Switzerland, but its value is so great that no one can buy it. Many years later, Evalyn McLean, daughter of millionaire McLean, after enjoying her father's inheritance, used all that money to buy this diamond. She often wears it at evening parties in the film industry, and is praised by the press as the person with the most beautiful jewelry. Not long after, this girl also died in a very strange and mysterious way at a very young age.

Because of her debauched and wasteful life, Evalyn is in a lot of debt. To cover the cost, the diamond fell into the hands of banker Thomas Hope.

Since owning the diamond, this man's family has encountered a lot of trouble, the couple divorced, the children were in discord, and litigation was fought over property, creating a lot of scandals in the press. Since then, this diamond has been known as a curse for those who own it. In the end, billionaire Hope's family also had to run out of assets. Mr. Hope's nephew then donated this diamond to the Smithsonian museum for exhibition because no one dared to keep or own it anymore.

I nodded:

- I have heard about the four Hope diamonds and the tragic disaster that happened to the people involved, but why do you know the background and journey of these diamonds so well?

The Jewish old man proudly said:

- The work of making valuable jewelry is carefully recorded. All jewelers who design works of art record their work in documents for future generations to learn from. This is a tradition of the jewelry profession that has existed for hundreds of years.

The old man concluded:

- Treasures of great value often come with misfortune. Illegal wealth caused by looting and appropriation brings misfortunes that few people know about. When an object has great value, it makes others covet it and causes trouble. If there is no theft, it will still be appropriated. Because of greed, so many people have died or lost their families. History has clearly recorded that those who unjustly take property from others must pay a very high price - if not at this time, then at another time. The more you take over, the more unfortunate things you will encounter. If you are not poor, you will encounter unexpected accidents, and by that time it will be too late to regret. Even though I'm just a jewelry designer, I carefully researched jewelry and jewelry documents from the past, so I've learned quite a bit. Today, I had the good fortune to tell you about it, I hope you don't mind it.

Two months later, I received a ring shaped like a scarab beetle exactly like the ring I saw in the photo from the jewelry store. It must be said that it is a masterpiece made by this very skillful jeweler. If compared to the ring in the London museum, it looks exactly like the real thing.

One day, I sat in my office, accidentally focusing on the ring that I had been wearing for the past few weeks. Suddenly there was a strange force that made me feel ecstatic and fall asleep without even realizing it.

* * *

I found myself standing in front of a temple in the desert with a group of priests. I tried to control myself, but like last time, I knew I was in a different body than the one I have now. Because I had the experience, I asked myself: "Am I remembering some past life again?"

At that moment, my whole body trembled and I clearly heard the priest's voice saying:

- It's time for you to take advantage of this rare opportunity - otherwise there will be no more chances. Although he was not entirely Egyptian, he was still of royal blood. He was born in Egypt, which means he is related to this country and wherever he is born, he has responsibility for that place. When he was born in Egypt, he absorbed the essence of this land and became indebted to it. Whether you like it or not, your fate and this country's are closely linked. He must fulfill his duty as a citizen of this country, especially when the country falls into danger.

Even though I know I am in another body, my mind is still confused because I don't know what's going on. At that moment, a majestic soldier walked in:

- Sir, the soldiers are ready. We await your orders.

I didn't know how to react because my mind was still dizzy, it seemed like I was dreaming but it wasn't a dream, but I knew that I was no longer Thomas but a different person, living in another life, in another era. At that time, suddenly my subconscious became active, then the past appeared clearly like a movie.

My name is Akhon, the son of a concubine in the Egyptian dynasty.

In the past, Pharaoh toured the lower Nile region and captured a number of Kushite slaves, including many beautiful women. The king brought these people back to the palace as concubines. Because I am a child of two bloodlines, Egyptian and Kush, and these two countries are often at war with each other, I am not considered an official prince. Life in the palace looks luxurious and happy on the outside, but inside is actually a battlefield with plots and disputes between factions of palace concubines. As a child of mixed blood, the son of an unfavored concubine, I became a victim of these disputes.

When my mother died, I was treated with brutal discrimination by the other princes in the palace. However, as a resilient child with Kush blood running through my veins, the more I was treated poorly, the more I burned with the will to take revenge. One day, I was chased and beaten fiercely by a group of princes, so I had to hide in the temple of the Sun god. Here, I was protected by the missionaries, so after that I often sought shelter here. Thanks to the loving teachings of the missionaries, I learned a lot about Egyptian religion.

The Egyptian temples at that time actually did not belong entirely to religion but were an educational system that included many fields such as astronomy, geography, architecture, medicine, music, etc. Students had the right to choose these areas of expertise. Only a few were trained to become priests living in temples, specializing in performing rituals, making offerings to gods, casting spells, or embalming the dead.

Egyptian religion originated in ancient times, no one knows when it appeared or where it came from, but this religious doctrine teaches that in the beginning, heaven and earth were just a mass of chaos deep in the dark night. After that, the Sun God Ra appeared to sweep away the dark night with sunlight, bringing order to the world by distinguishing between day and night, or the four seasons, etc. The teachings of Sun Ra worship teach that human life is like day and night, meaning people live and die, then are revived and live in another world. Therefore, life in the afterlife is more important than the present life and preparation for this Many Lives, Many Times is carefully planned in every detail. According to the Egyptians, after death, people will enter a dark, murky world with many demons and evil forces in the afterlife. If they are not carefully guided, they will fall into this world and become slaves to demons or creatures of the underworld, and then become a demon living there forever. But if they are helped by the gods through rituals with special charms and spells, they will be brought to the realm of the gods and become a god living happily in that realm.

Based on this concept, Egyptian religion advocates worshiping many gods because these gods can help them in the afterlife. Therefore, rituals of offering offerings to the gods are important to please the gods because the gods can bless or bring disaster, depending on the value of the offerings.

The leader of Egypt, or Pharaoh, is considered an intermediary between the people and the gods, so he is responsible for building temples and offering offerings to the gods to ensure order and prosperity in society.

Egypt is a country with most of the land being desert, so buried corpses are not often damaged and can be kept for a long time.

However, when dug up, these dried corpses all have terrible and ugly shapes. Because the Egyptians believe that there is Many Lives, Many Times after death, embalming and building tombs and mausoleums are important rituals to ensure that the dead will keep their body as beautiful as when they were alive and be brought to good realms by the gods.

Accordingly, embalming rituals were established so that the dead person's soul could enter it when living in the afterlife. Depending on the grave built with the body preserved by embalming, along with the rituals, spells and rituals of the priests, the dead will be brought back by the gods to live happily in the afterlife. For kings, mandarins or wealthy elites, building tombs and maintaining the body after death to ensure life in the afterlife has become a tradition deeply rooted in the culture of this country, so almost everyone who is able takes care of building their own tomb while still alive.

During Egypt's history of more than six thousand years, conflicts between the clergy and the Pharaoh occurred very often due to the clash of interests between the two sides. When the clerical group was strong, they required the court to build many temples, support many clerics, and offer offerings according to their requirements (such as food, wine, gold, silver, jewels, slaves and women) for their enjoyment. When the Pharaoh was strong, they did not want to spend funds on building temples or offering offerings but focused on building tombs for themselves and only they could enjoy these benefits.

* * *

When I was twelve years old, thanks to the intervention of the head monk of the Sun Temple, I was sent to the desolate border area under the supervision of an elderly martial artist. For the princes

In the palace, I was considered "exiled" and they believed that it would be difficult for me to survive in such a wild border area. However, here I was treated as a child by this military mandarin and taught him carefully. Although life in the desert is harsh for weak people, it instilled in me the determination to not back down in the face of difficulties. Thanks to the education and dedicated guidance of the military man whom I considered my adoptive father, when I grew up, I became his effective assistant and achieved many glorious victories. When the military officer passed away, I became the commander of the army stationed in the desert border area.

That year, the Pharaoh died, the princes fought to usurp the throne, so civil war broke out in the country. In just a short time, four Pharaohs ascended the throne, each of whom only held the throne for a few months, so the social situation became chaotic. The court is no longer in control. Mandarins everywhere competed in plundering and appropriating everything they could get. Taking that opportunity, the Nubians in the south sent troops to occupy Egyptian land. The black king of Nubia proclaimed himself Pharaoh and immediately established a dynasty in Egypt with the intention of ruling this country.

That day, Satt, the priest of the Thai Duong temple, came to me. He said:

- Currently, the situation is extremely dangerous because outside, the Nubians are sending troops to annex Egypt, while inside the court is in turmoil due to disputes between royal factions.

Now it's time for him to return to take the throne as Pharaoh because no one can lead Egypt at this time.

I answered:

- I know my identity clearly, I am just the child of an unofficial concubine, and a person of mixed blood. The Egyptians would never accept a person of Kush bloodline as the Pharaoh of this country.

Satt smiled:

- We clergy discussed this with each other and proposed

to organize a wedding between you and Princess Nedjem. Currently, Egypt is ruled by Pharaoh Amose, the father of Princess Nedjem, but he is an incompetent king, addicted to alcohol, spending all day worrying about enjoyment and not caring about state affairs.

He was also appointed to the throne of Pharaoh by a group of court officials just to give them the opportunity to increase taxes, embezzle funds through mausoleum construction projects, and exploit the people's property. However, his position is not stable because the plot to compete for power between royal factions is still going on. Bringing a military commander like you to be the king's son-in-law will help Pharaoh Amose maintain his position. After marrying Princess Nedjem, he will automatically become an official prince. From there, he can restore social order, reorganize the court and become Pharaoh.

I was surprised by the unexpected proposal and wondered:

- But Amose is currently the Pharaoh.

Satt laughed:

- Don't worry, our clergy have a plan. After you become

an official prince with your bravery in defeating foreign invaders and earning the respect of the people, we will take care of Amose's future.

I was surprised:

- What happened after Amose? How can I compete for status with my father-in-law

?

Satt smiled:

- With just a dose of poison given by a doctor, everything will calm down. You don't have to worry about this.

After a while of calming down, I doubted:

- What's the benefit of doing that?

Satt said solemnly:

- He is the one who has been educated in the Sun temple since childhood.

His religious knowledge was trained by the clergy, so he is one of us. We only hope that after ascending to the throne of Pharaoh, he will repair and build many temples, protect the rights of the clergy, and develop religion in Egypt.

As soon as I heard it, I realized immediately: "So that's it, the clergy protecting and training me as a child, sending me to the border to avoid disputes in the royal court was just a carefully calculated plan. Then I am just a pawn in the political chessboard to increase my power." only the influence and power of this group of clergy.”

The plan seemed feasible and I could not refuse this attractive offer. Everything went as Satt had planned. After the wedding, I immediately started an army to suppress the rebels in the court. The princes and mandarins in the palace who had treated me harshly were all thrown into the dark dungeon to feed the lions and starved for many days. After that, I led my army to attack Nubia. In just a few major battles, the king of this country withdrew his army and surrendered, and had to pay tribute every year with gold, silver, jewels, and slaves to the court. Order in the country was restored, the people were overjoyed. During the banquet celebrating my victory, the drunken Pharaoh Amose suddenly fell down and died. So the entire court honored me as Pharaoh that very evening.

The next day, Satt brought a jeweler to make a royal seal ring for me. The jeweler respectfully said:

- Please give Pharaoh instructions so that I can make you a royal seal.

I answered:

- I want a ring with a large ruby ​​embedded in it, with the words "May the Sun God Amun Ra protect me" on the back. Because my name is Akhon (falcon), I chose Horus, the god of Justice with the face of a falcon, as the protector of the nation.

Satt happily said:

- Just hearing that, we missionaries know that we did not choose the wrong person. Not only is he worthy of being the Pharaoh to rule this land, but he is also a man of strong faith.

With Horus the god of Justice as his protector, this nation will flourish under his reign.

Since becoming Pharaoh, I immediately issued strict laws to reform the society that had been decadent since the time of the previous Pharaohs. The first thing is to punish those who disobey the law but are still tolerated and protected by corrupt officials. Thieves were sent to border areas to work as mausoleum builders. Those who embezzled public funds and royal assets were thrown into the lion's den, and their families were exiled to the desert and could no longer live in the city. Those who are rich exploit and appropriate other people's property. In serious cases, they are sentenced to death. In serious cases, they are locked up in leprosy camps to live with disabled people. The law in my hands is a strict, brutal law, but I do not hesitate to enforce it, no matter what. With the hatred from being treated cruelly in the past and the ferocious blood of the Kush race flowing in my veins, in just a short time, I became a powerful, domineering Pharaoh. Every time I raise the finger wearing the royal seal, the entire court trembles before my power.

As someone who has witnessed the brutal plots of the palace servants, when I ascended the throne of Pharaoh, I immediately established a group of trusted elite detectives to control everything, from inside the palace to outside the court, to make sure that nothing could escape my eyes. I replaced all the officials in the court and only recruited talented people trained by the priests in the Thai Duong temple to hold important positions.

I also raised troops to destroy the surrounding countries, captured a lot of gold, silver, jewels and slaves, then built many Thai Duong temples in the border areas, so I received the full support of the clergy.

Although the court was stable, the country complied with the law, Society is in order, no longer worried about foreign invasion, but for some reason I still don't feel satisfied. There is still a strange emptiness in my heart. The fun in the court and the rituals in the Thai Duong temple do not make me feel comfortable.

It seems like I still want something that I can't name.

On a moonless night, I stood alone in the palace, looked out at the vast desert and felt an infinite sadness.

After so much hard work, so many heroic victories, being respected by so many people, achieving the supreme position with ultimate authority, I still wonder if life is just like that. Is there anything else? When living in the desert, there were nights when I sat alone looking into endless space and wondered about the meaning of life. Even though I was taught religious doctrine by the priests at the Sun Temple since childhood, I was not satisfied with these things. There seemed to be something motivating me to learn more, but at that time I was preoccupied with many other things. Now, everything is done, I have become a Pharaoh, the ultimate power, living in a golden palace, having everything that people often desire, but I am still haunted by a strange feeling of lack and loneliness. I stayed awake many nights because of that strange feeling of emptiness. I feel like I still need to do something, but what can I do now? All that can be done, I have done. Now should be the time for me to enjoy the results of my work! But I can't.

I raised my eyes to the sky with thousands of sparkling stars and wondered about the meaning of life. Was my fate of becoming the ultimate authority pre-arranged by the gods? Why are dozens of princes in the palace who daily make offerings to the gods not allowed to become Pharaohs, while a person of mixed blood like me, living in a desolate border region with no offerings, can get that blessing? Why are some people born in rich lands next to the Nile River like Egypt, while others have to live in dry, rocky mountains like Kush, or hot deserts like Nubia? Why are some people born into wealthy and happy families, while others are born into poverty and misery? Why are some people made officials, while others have to be slaves? Why do the gods do that? Why do the gods demand offerings but let the priests enjoy them? For what purpose are humans born when everything is pre-arranged by the gods? Are humans just slaves of the gods? I want to ask the gods about this, but who can I ask? Having lived with missionaries as a child, I saw clearly how these people lived, how they enjoyed offerings, what their needs and demands were. They often threaten the gods to demand more offerings, then share the enjoyment. They only explained vaguely and could not clearly answer my questions.

I worship the Sun Amun Ra and silently ask him questions during rituals with precious items, but for some reason he remains silent and does not answer my questions. I went to the temple of goddess Isis [4] , her face was covered with a cloth so no one could admire the goddess's face. I was taught by the priests that Isis represents things that cannot be said or understood, so it is best to just offer offerings and leave everything to the gods to arrange. As a person with a strong will and stubborn mind, I cannot accept that everything that happens is arranged by the gods.

I once asked:

- How do I know what the gods want? If Pharaoh is the intermediary between the gods and the people, then I must clearly know the wishes of the gods?

The clergy could not answer this question, so they explained that Pharaoh was also a god and whatever Pharaoh wanted, the gods also wanted. That time, I asked back, if that was the case, why were only the priests allowed to enjoy the offerings and not the Pharaoh or anyone else? No one among the clergy dares to answer these difficult questions, so they often try to avoid such meetings. But who can help me answer hundreds of questions about the meaning of my life here?

While thinking deeply, I was suddenly startled by the sound of laughter and music resounding in the palace. behead them all.

The noise gradually quieted down and in just a split second, I found myself alone in the palace in the middle of a quiet night.

I wanted to continue thinking more about the meaning of life and other strange questions, but at that time I was no longer interested. I slowly walked through the bustling late-night markets, where some people still gathered to do business under flickering torches. - Most children's diseases are caused by lack of care or love. Most of the parents of these children are busy with their livelihoods, few have time to take care of them, especially newborn babies. I was surprised and somewhat angry:

- I am a physician and have been trained in medicine for many years, but medical school does not teach love. The clergy also know nothing about love. I felt really uncomfortable with his explanation:

. Currently, Egyptian society is peaceful, everyone enjoys peace.

I was so angry that my chest was full but I didn't want to reveal my identity. Normally, with just one finger raised, this old man could be thrown into the lion's den. I turned to look at the girl still holding the child.

to caress and cherish. A mother is love and certainly nothing harms children more than the lack of a mother's love.

I asked:

The old man laughed:

so I consider Cihone as my own child. As a physician, I clearly see that a mother's lack of love not only slows a child's development but also causes many diseases. Children who are susceptible to illness and slow growth are often caused by a lack of loving care.

The old man paused as if to let me think, then continued:

- Think about it, if lack of love is so harmful, what will happen to children without parents? They will grow up abnormally. On the contrary, if not, then its ability to love will be lost and it will only know how to live unconsciously. How can it love anyone if it has never been loved by anyone before? How can it love anyone when it has never been loved by anyone? How can it sympathize with the suffering of others when its ability to love and empathize has been stunted? Therefore, the relationship between it and the people around it will become superficial, and limited to very small things, unable to reach far or soar high. I tried to suppress my anger because the old man's unintentional words had touched my status, then spoke up to defend:

I was angry and trembling because the insolent statement offended me so much, but the old man still unintentionally continued:

- Do you think, what will the future of Egypt be like when every family is busy building mausoleums, and then these children grow up without care, education and lack of love? What will their future be like when they grow up with bad habits, only knowing how to be greedy, compete or appropriate? If they are not taught and educated from a young age, how can these children know what the previous generation has worked hard to build?

Listening to the old man, although I was extremely angry, I was also startled to discover something that I had never thought of before.

- Nowadays, most families have to build temples for priests and Pharaohs. Not many people can take care of their children except feeding them. Children who grow up without careful training are susceptible to bad habits. Young children are not cared for and cared for, so they get sick a lot. - So what do you usually do with these children?

The old man replied:

The old man sighed:

This last word of the old man made me angry because it directly pointed to my cruel actions when ascending the throne of Pharaoh. I turned to look at the girl who was patting the baby standing in the distance. There was something special about her that I couldn't explain that caught my attention. At that moment, I recalled an ancient feeling, when I was a child, I was also loved by my mother like that. I have never loved or loved anyone, and have never been loved by anyone. All the beautiful maids only know how to please me because it is their duty, without love. That is an undeniable truth. I looked back at the other girl, she had a gentle look that was very similar to my mother in the past. Suddenly I found myself smiling at that girl, but she was still engrossed in cuddling the baby, not paying attention to the stranger who was staring at her.

I slowly walked out of the old doctor's house but did not return to the palace immediately but went straight through the Thai Duong temple. Satt was surprised to see me coming at this hour.

Satt timidly:

One afternoon, the sun had just set but there was still a little light glistening on the surface of the Nile River. In this supreme position, everyone lives in fear. Every Pharaoh is afraid of being betrayed.

Every pharaoh was afraid to confess his feelings to others. Every Pharaoh is afraid, because they have things they cannot express. All those who have been successful, famous, and extremely wealthy live in anxiety and fear because those are the most powerful but also the loneliest positions. People cannot escape loneliness by partying all night long. One cannot escape loneliness with beautiful maids. People cannot escape loneliness with busy government work. People cannot escape loneliness with fun because even in the middle of a noisy crowd - loneliness still pursues them to the end.

I blankly looked at the flock of birds flying at the end of the horizon, then as if something pushed me, I quickly put on an old robe, pulled the scarf up to cover my face, and walked out of the palace alone. I also want to meet again the girl who has a gentle and gentle personality, very similar to my mother in the past.

I'm happy:

- Taxes are getting higher and higher, so people like me have to move to a far away, remote place like this. Most of the people here work at the construction site of the Pharaoh's tomb and temples for the clergy. Their wages are low and they are also exploited and beaten continuously.

At that moment, there were footsteps outside and the girl Cihone walked in. I'm interested right away:

Cihone's words startled everyone back to reality, silently turning to look at me as if searching.

The two words "courage" have a strange power that reminds me of a childhood memory. I returned to the palace in a state of discomfort and frustration. I don't understand why the unintentional but sincere words of these people have the power to strike directly at my arrogant mind, disturbing my heart.

I remembered the gentle voice and behavior of that gentle girl and suddenly felt really bitter in my heart. Why would a majestic and powerful Pharaoh feel disappointed and embarrassed before a girl from such an ordinary background? Never have I felt so helpless. Who put me in this strange, ironic situation? Who can answer what I'm asking? If everything is the will of the gods, why are they so evil? Since the day I ascended the throne as Pharaoh, I have offered many gifts to the gods, so why did they put me in this ironic situation? Was it a test of my faith in the gods or something else?
