Subsequent generations of descendants could no longer preserve the quintessence of ancient civilization, so many scientific subjects were lost. In addition, some Atlanteans also brought a different religion with black magic, spells, and calling for contact with creatures of the invisible world, so disputes occurred between these two groups.

When one group wants to destroy another group, no one is willing to give in, causing religious disputes that make Egyptian life no longer peaceful. From small disputes between individuals to large disputes between factions, the two sides then use all available knowledge to harm each other. When the quintessence of scientific subjects was lost, groups using black magic prevailed, and temples became places to sell gods and sell saints instead of learning sublime knowledge. The clergy turned it into a religion of theocracy and superstition. Scientific civilization was replaced by huge temples with priests who only knew how to practice rituals but did not understand much. The clergy and their families became a high class with strong influence, forcing the people to serve and provide for them. The distinction between high and low castes from Atlantis was restored because these people had not learned the lesson they needed to learn.

When the religion of worshiping the Sun turned into a religion that favored theocracy and superstition, Egyptian society also changed. With the ambition to expand religious power, the clergy incited the Pharaohs to expand their territory by invading other countries.

Pharaoh dynasties such as Ahmose, Thutmose, Amenhotep, Seti, and Ramses were all tyrants who always waged war with neighboring countries. Among all the Pharaohs of that era (1800 - 1400 BC), except for Akhenaten, the only Pharaoh with the virtue of peace [8] , most of the other Pharaohs liked to wage war, depleting the country's human resources and creating very deep negative karma. Ramses II, the longest-ruling king, more than sixty-five years, waged wars everywhere, slaughtering people from surrounding countries. The North defeated the Hittites, forcing them into the arid mountains of Mitani, causing famine and epidemics that destroyed half of the country's population. From then on, the Hittites were exhausted, and were destroyed by the Assyrians. In the south, Ramses appropriated most of the gold mines of Nubia, captured tens of thousands of slaves to build his tombs, and then sent troops to destroy the capital of Kush. During these wars of invasion, many innocent people died. Therefore, Egypt later had to bear the consequences of its karma.

Today, Egyptian history honors Pharaoh Ramses as a great king because of his merits in expanding the territory, building magnificent temples and mausoleums with more than two hundred rooms carved deep into the cliffs.

Most historians only know how to highlight the merits of tyrants through glorious victories without mentioning the tens of thousands of slaves who died in the process of completing these tombs, as well as the hundreds of thousands of people who died in wars with neighboring kingdoms. Because of the crazy ambitions of the Pharaohs, the Egyptian people had to pay a very high price.

I lost patience and asked what I wanted to know at that moment:

- What was the fate of me - the lone Pharaoh after that? Can I destroy that group of heretical priests? How is Queen Nedjem? Miss Cihone again?

Mr. Kris looked at me attentively, smiled, then continued:

- He was not alone, but his personality was not accepting, so he

became different, therefore lonely. During his life in Egypt, he was one of the Pharaohs of the last dynasty of ancient Egypt. He became Pharaoh when Egypt was in decline due to dynastic disputes as well as the consequences of building tombs for previous Pharaohs. At this time, the power of the cleric faction was very strong so he could not rule for long.

Due to a lack of weapons and inadequate preparation, that winter, the Egyptian army invaded countries around the region and lost miserably. The clergy knew of Pharaoh's intention to destroy them, so they blamed Pharaoh for ordering a halt to the construction of the temple and offerings to the gods. The people were dissatisfied because they had no work, so they rebelled. As Pharaoh, he was responsible for these things before he could finish them. He was poisoned to death by a group of clerics before starting an army to deal with the clerics and rebels. Because his tomb was not completed at that time, Queen Nedjem had to hastily bury him in another place, so shortly after his tomb was stolen by thieves. The clerics took advantage of the social chaos and brought troops to control Thebes and the upper reaches of the Nile River. The royal family members had to flee to the South, close to the border of Nubia, then raise their descendants to the throne of Pharaoh to establish a court there, but no one could do anything significant.

I was surprised and stunned when I heard about my tragic fate, so I was about to ask, but Mr. Kris did not let me interrupt and continued:

- Not long after, Nubia invaded Egypt, the Nubian king also proclaimed himself Pharaoh, so Egyptian history became complicated because there was no one left. differentiate between Egyptian Pharaoh and Nubian Pharaoh too.

At that time, the Egyptians had to serve the Nubian people, a people they despised and considered barbarians.

Afterwards, the Assyrians in the Northeast drove out the clergy in Thebes, as well as the royal court of the Nubian Pharaoh, occupied Egypt and established the Assyrian empire. The Egyptians had to pay a very expensive debt and serve the Assyrians.

Then, Persia invaded the Assyrian empire, putting Egypt under their rule, and once again the Egyptians had to suffer the tragedy of being colonized. After that, Greece under the command of Alexander the Great occupied Persia, placing Egypt under the yoke of domination. The Greek generals became the Pharaohs of Egypt. When the Greek empire collapsed, the Romans took over Egypt and ruled the country for several hundred years. Then the Arabs occupied Egypt, erased its culture, and annexed the country into their Caliphate territory. More recently, France and England also occupied Egypt, ruling Egypt until 1922, before allowing the people of this country some autonomy.

Mr. Kris sighed and looked at me, still in shock:

- Did you see it? For nearly three thousand years, the Egyptian people had to live under colonial rule and invasion. Most of Egypt's culture, customs, writing, and literature were erased, leaving only a few pyramids and tombs of the Pharaohs to remind the Egyptians of their glorious past. Now he can understand the karma of the wars that ancient Egyptian kings caused to this country.

I was filled with emotions at that time:

- I learned the lesson of love in Egypt, but what about the fate of Cihone and Queen Nedjem after that? He still hasn't told me...

Mr. Kris smiled and looked at me sympathetically:

- If you're in love, there must be fate. He had quite a deep spiritual connection with these women, so he certainly met them again in later lives.

* * *

Thomas shared with me about the situation in ancient Egypt, as well as the

The corruption of the clerical class, they took advantage of the people's faith to consolidate their power and increase their interests. For the clergy, the construction of large temples was a form of strengthening faith in the theocratic powers of which they were intermediary representatives.

The clergy class at that time all had families and enjoyed great benefits (such as being granted land, slaves and enjoying offerings by the royal court).

At the end of the Egyptian Pharaoh's reign, the clerical faction became a very strong power that dominated everything, controlling the economy, taxes, and even the army. They controlled more than half of Egypt, from Thebes to the north, for many years. The Pharaoh's descendants had to flee to the South, set up a court near the Nubian border and were soon conquered by the Nubians.

According to Mr. Thomas, the construction of temples everywhere, the increase in taxes to support the clerical class, which at that time numbered hundreds of thousands of people, only enjoying themselves without doing anything, were also the causes of despair and depression among the people, making Egypt an easy prey for surrounding countries such as Assyria, Nubia and Ba Tu.

Mr. Thomas also shared that through contact with Cihone and Nedjem, he learned lessons about love and sacrifice, which were lessons that helped him a lot in subsequent lives.

I asked him about reincarnating into an insect through Mr. Kris's revelation. He sadly said that he did not remember anything about this, but believed that being human is a great honor and that it is not easy to have a human body, and if lost, it is not easy to return. He said that if you are conscious like that, you must know how to live according to the meaning of a human being.

When we talked about battles in the history of ancient civilizations, such as the battle of Troy, I asked Mr. Thomas his opinion on war. He said that war is an extremely destructive force because it causes loss of life and property, as well as destroys cultures and the best of humanity. The cause of war stems from greed. Greed for fame, greed for profit, greed for power and ambition to take over everything. From this greed is born jealousy, hatred and nurtures the seeds of war.

Although the Trojan War originated from the fact that Prince Paris of Troy kidnapped Helen, the wife of Menelaus, King of Sparta, and brought it back to Troy. Afterwards, Menelaus called on his allies to bring troops to besiege Troy to reclaim his wife, but according to Mr. Thomas, that was only the reason the story was recorded in Greek mythology through the pen of the poet Homer. The main reason was that Sparta's allies took advantage of this opportunity to attack Troy because this was a very rich and powerful country, located in an important position, controlling the main sea routes of Greece to Central Asian countries. Capturing Troy meant controlling the entire economy, trade, and transportation of the Mediterranean region. Therefore, Agamemnon, Achilles, Odysseus and many other Greek generals all wanted to take over this domain. The Battle of Troy lasted more than ten years, killing countless soldiers on both sides. Immediately after the battle ended, the surviving characters also had to go through many difficulties and obstacles to return to their homeland; But when they got there, they realized that everything had changed, even the old people were no longer the same. That is the tragedy of the Trojan War, a Greek myth about the tragedy of war.

According to Mr. Thomas, if we want to end war, we cannot oppose or fight it, because if we oppose war, another war will start in our hearts. When we oppose a person, an idea, or a concept, we are stirring up another war deep within our hearts. For the same reason, in human history, war never ends. After one war, there is another war because there is always hatred in everyone's hearts. If we look back at the lessons of history, we will clearly see that the causes of battles are greed, selfishness and hatred. They have nurtured wrong concepts, theories and goals, leading to conflicts between opposing groups. When we have hatred and anger, we are always ready to go to war. The best way to end war is to eliminate hatred right in your heart by developing love and compassion.

Mr. Thomas said that through experiences in many lives, the important driving force guiding his life is love. Thanks to love, he has overcome many challenges and continues to learn more about it.

tieu_de: Part Six: Reincarnation of Civilizations - Nothing Lasts Forever
noi_dung:
PART SIX

Reincarnation

CIVILIZATION

NOTHING IS FOREVER

After meeting and talking with Mr. Kris about my life in Egypt, I prepared to return to New York. Before leaving for the airport, I asked:

- Yesterday you said that my life in Atlantis was not the first life, so are there any other lives that I don't remember?

Mr. Kris replied:

- He had many lives before that. Most people living in this world have gone through many lives that few remember. Because they are not clearly aware of what they have done or what they have learned in those lives, most people still remain in the cycle of reincarnation. Sometimes this way, sometimes that way, sometimes human, sometimes animal, sometimes demonic. You should know, people's lives did not just begin a few thousand years ago.

I was surprised:

- Human civilization has only begun a few thousand years ago, so what was human life like in the past?

Mr. Kris explained:

- Humans have been on this earth for a long time. Since ancient times, there have been civilizations that have now disappeared from the face of the earth. Archaeologists believe that humanity only began to live civilized a few thousand years ago because the oldest civilization originated in the Mesopotamia region of Iraq and Syria, around five thousand years BC. Most do not accept that there are other, more ancient civilizations.

Not long ago, an archaeological team found in the Gobi desert, northwest of Tibet, the remains of a village with stone utensils and water sewers estimated to have existed about ten thousand years BC.

No one knows anything about this civilization so there is still much debate, based on the notion that civilization always starts from places near rivers or seas. A civilization located in the middle of the desert is unacceptable. However, thousands of years ago, the Gobi and Tibetan deserts were originally seas, not mountains or deserts. Earthquakes pushed the Indian continent north, forming the Himalayas. Although geologists have proven this, many archaeologists still maintain the stance that the cradle of civilization of the world originated in Mesopotamia in the Middle East, then spread throughout the world.

I asked:

- Why do they believe that?

Mr. Kris laughed:

- Because European archaeologists believe that everything originates from a single place and then spreads to other places. Few people accept that many civilizations have emerged in different parts of the world. This is similar to the notion that human ancestors were apes that originated in Africa, then gave birth to children, and migrated around the world. Of course, when more evidence is discovered, this concept will have to change.

I said:

- I know about my life in Atlantis, but few people believe that the true civilization of Atlantis exists. Most people think that it is just a legend that was exaggerated by Plato.

Mr. Kris smiled:

- This is understandable because currently no one has found any evidence of this civilization. In today's scientific era, people need clear evidence before coming to conclusions. In your case, understanding past lives will help you have a clear understanding of universal laws such as the laws of Samsara and Karma. From there, he could continue on the path he had pursued in many previous lives. Therefore, remembering these memories only benefits you.

I asked further:

- Yesterday you said that I have the ability to recall past life memories, which have now been forgotten. How is that?

Mr. Kris immediately replied:

- That's right, he had that ability from his previous life but knew he would forget, so he asked me to help. Therefore, we have the opportunity to meet again in this life.

I eagerly asked:

- What was that? Can you tell me?

Mr. Kris smiled and replied:

- You have to find this out for yourself when reminiscing about past lives. If I say it at this time, it won't do anything and will only confuse him more.

I was surprised:

- So how do I find that ability again?

Mr. Kris seriously replied:

- You need to restore that ability through the elaborate practice of introspection that you have done before.

- Are you talking about practicing meditation? Where and how should I learn to meditate?

- Currently, there are many places that teach meditation, but this name has been used indiscriminately and is very misleading. Perhaps you also see that most meditation centers today are commercialized by people calling themselves Zen Masters, Gurus, Gurus or Saints. They only teach for the purpose of becoming famous or making money.

- If so, what should I do?

- Before going any further, let's avoid using the word meditation for now. Meditation is a Buddhist word that refers to the method of introspection. Other religions also have similar methods but the purpose is completely different. The Hindu method focuses on integrating the Small Self into the Greater Self. The Christian method, or contemplation, focuses on returning to God. There are also many methods of magicians or witches aimed at practicing magical powers or allowing spirits to enter and manipulate. Therefore, when starting, you must be careful and should only consider it as a calming method to calm your mind, not stress, to control your thoughts and emotions before going further.

- So how do I start?

- If you know that thoughts and emotions are often expressed through certain gestures, then certain postures also tend to create corresponding states and emotions. Thanks to knowing how to apply these postures, his body was conditioned, then he was able to go further. Most Westerners have a stiff body and are not used to sitting on the ground, so you can start by sitting in a chair, keeping your back straight, with your hands naturally placed on your knees. Legs closed. The main thing is to be comfortable, not to try or be constrained. Keep your body straight, don't bend over, let the vitality flow evenly through your spine.

I ask more:

- I see people who meditate all sit, so is there any difference between sitting on a chair and sitting on the ground?

Mr. Kris patiently answered:

- When first practicing, posture was not important until he could master his body. Of course, he can sit cross-legged in positions such as half-lotus or cross-lotus. For Asians, sitting cross-legged is a natural movement but not convenient for Westerners.

If you are forced to sit in a certain position right from the start, it will create unnecessary difficulties. You should remember that when your body is comfortable, you can naturally regulate your breathing. Once he has mastered his breathing, he can change his position to sit more firmly. When first practicing, everyone feels pain in their legs and arms because they are not used to sitting, so I advise you to start slowly, not hastily.

I said:

- Angie was taught to meditate for about fifteen minutes before starting Yoga movements or postures.

Mr. Kris laughed:

- Some places that teach Yoga often add a few things and call it meditation or qigong to create a mysterious look. You should remember that the initial positions only help you breathe lightly and deeply. In fact, when the body is comfortable and in harmony, breathing can be deep and rhythmic. If this continues, at some point, the breathing will become soft and gradually deepen.

Mr. Kris suddenly said seriously:

- Many beginners are taught to breathe deeply, pouring the breath into their abdomen like singers practicing their voices. This is harmful because people only focus on breathing and forget that calming down is to relax the mind, not trying to breathe makes the lungs and heart work abnormally. Many people practice breathing but forget that this is about controlling thoughts, not a sport. Some people teach you to put your breath into acupuncture points, sending it along the meridian system in the body to achieve something. This is the practice of some witches, and is very dangerous because it can cause neurological disorders. Many people are taught to raise their eyes high and keep them in that position to paralyze their vision as if hypnotized and enter a trance state, causing strange phenomena or being guided by spirits. This is something that must be absolutely avoided because calming down is to relax the mind and eliminate unnecessary thoughts, not to achieve anything.

The calming method helps the body and mind relax before starting to focus your thoughts to go further. If you pay attention to your posture and then feel pain in your legs and arms, how can you control your thoughts? Practicing should not be hasty or rash, but should let everything come naturally. Remember, retreat is intellectual, moral and spiritual development to master thoughts and emotions. It is not the development of a magical ability to achieve something. Don't confuse meditation with cultivating some magical power or wanting to achieve something. The initial effort is just to practice a positive habit to achieve peace and eliminate messy thoughts in the mind. When messy thoughts have been eliminated and the mind is at peace, everything will be different.

The most important thing is to maintain the practice time. Once you have chosen a specific time to meditate, you need to keep it because you need to have a habit, otherwise it will be difficult to go far. You should practice early in the morning, when the sun begins to rise because this is when the electric currents in nature are very strong. You should not practice after meals or late at night because it has adverse effects. You can start practicing for about fifteen minutes and then increase it to thirty minutes, then you can increase it to forty-five minutes or more.

Sometimes when you practice for a long time and your body is tense and tired, you can stand up and walk leisurely for about fifteen minutes to let your body regulate again.

After practicing for a while, when your body is completely comfortable, your breathing is regulated and gentle, let your thoughts focus on something good to avoid thoughts running around or being disturbed by daily work. This is a very difficult task because his mind is used to thinking about everything.

Mr. Kris concluded:

- You should remember that this method of calming down requires effort,

not a feeling of dreaminess, half-consciousness. You can imagine the person who practices this method as a seagull flying over the sea. The seagull spread its wings, gliding with the wind over the water. On the outside it looks motionless, but actually it has to try very hard to cope with the strong winds, always adjusting its wings according to the changes in the wind, so it is conscious every second of every moment to not be blown away by the wind into the sea.

* * *

I returned to New York, continued my daily work but spent half an hour every morning practicing meditation according to the method Mr. Kris taught. This surprised Angie because up until now I only usually read the newspaper or watch the news in the morning.

- In the past, you used to laugh at me and Connie going to yoga, but now why do you spend time sitting still like you're meditating?

I don't want to explain, so I make excuses:

- Lately my mind has been stressed so I just want to sit quietly and rest for a while before going to work.

One day, I was at work when Angie walked in with a flyer for a speaking engagement. Angie said:

- The other day, Connie and I went to see an exhibition about Egypt at the museum and saw this flyer so we took it home. Do you want to go listen with me?

I skimmed through the advertisement. It was a lecture by a university professor researching ancient civilizations. As if I had an urge, I nodded:

- Yes, let's just try to listen to what this person has to say.

The lecture was held at New York University, the speaker was a professor who, although not yet famous, had many serious research projects. The audience was not very large, most of them were just students who had to listen to write reports for their classes. I went with Angie and Andrew and his wife.

The speaker began with his research on civilizations in many countries around the world. He said:

- Among the ancient documents still circulating today, Jewish documents are still considered the most complete. Jewish scriptures often mention the covenant between humans and God through the basic precepts clearly stated in the Torah and the Old Testament. However, alongside these precepts there is an abstract concept of exile and return to the promised land. Most Jews believe that this is a historical event. In the past, the Jews were captured as slaves in Egypt but were later liberated. However, when they left Egypt, they violated the covenant between them and God, so they were punished, having to wander everywhere, without a homeland, and unable to return to the promised land.

Recently, archaeologists have found a document in the Dead Sea region explaining that exile is just a metaphor, referring to the loss of consciousness of divine origin, a spiritual decline of humans in general. The return to the promised land symbolizes the return to know who you are, to know the sacred and noble origin that is inherent in you. The covenant with God is nothing more than the development of the potential of understanding to live in accordance with the laws of nature. This has overturned the concept that has existed for thousands of years and created a heated debate among Jewish scholars.

Some scholars do not recognize this document because it would deny the "promised land", which was the land God gave to the Jewish people [9] . It is because of the notion that they are a race chosen by God, given a land as their homeland, that the Jews, despite wandering around the world for thousands of years, have always looked towards their "promised land". The introduction of archaeological documents with this new concept, even though it was written by an ancient rabbi, is unacceptable.

Some other scholars believe that the rabbi's document, written many thousands of years ago, explaining the hidden meaning of the mystical Kabbalah, is an important discovery and Jews cannot deny such a valuable document.

Jewish history clearly records that Kabbalah is a set of mystical books that were written by the author. Prophet Moses wrote in hieroglyphs with many hidden meanings. Since ancient times, prophets and Taoists often used a secret language, metaphors, and figurative sayings to describe some things that would happen in the future that they could not predict.

The Talmud clearly states: "Truth is not something to be talked about, but something that people can only understand through diligent practice." Therefore, ancient Taoists only taught their students through oral transmission, not many people wrote it down. If they must write down, they use allusions and hidden meanings and choose students very carefully after many tests to make sure they can understand these mysterious meanings.

Moses Ben Maimon ( Maimonides), the most famous and prestigious theologian on the Torah canon of Judaism, wrote: "Self-awareness is the basic law of all spiritual traditions because knowing oneself means knowing one's divine origin." The goal of all ancient spiritual traditions is self-knowledge. While today, it has been changed to target a distant object, something beyond human understanding. Worse still, it focuses more and more on external phenomena. That's why all solutions, all concepts, all theories of today's spiritual traditions cannot bring happiness to people because they are fundamentally wrong.

Recent archaeological research has found many documents showing that since ancient times, ancient people possessed profound knowledge in many fields, from astronomy to geography, from mathematics to metaphysics, from chemistry to medicine and called it mysticism rather than dividing it into many separate subjects like today. In rooms deep in magnificent temples, or natural stone caves in wild mountains and forests, ancient Taoists researched, learned and applied mystical powers to things that today, in the heyday of experimental science, are still considered impossible or miracles.

It is an insult to the ancients when the inexperienced scientists of this century dare to criticize their predecessors as ignorant sorcerers. It's like saying that for thousands of years, humanity has only been ignorant, foolish and superstitious, and it wasn't until the beginning of the twentieth century that people became wise. If you look at history, is there any country in the past that did not have heroes and great men who contributed to building civilization for their country? Were there any periods in the past when Taoists and scholars did not bring their culture to a golden and glorious peak? Why do people today deliberately forget history, forget the work of ancestors, and bury the good things of the past in the name of scientific progress? It is unfortunate that today scientists divide the knowledge of the ancients into discrete fragments, so they cannot have an overview but only know about very small pieces, but are proud to be intelligent.

If we look closely at the historical process, one can see many similarities between ancient civilizations from East to West. For example, two very ancient documents that are still handed down today are the Code of Manu and the Vedas of the Indians, in which the ancients meticulously recorded ritual rituals and prayers. If examined closely, one will see that these rituals are no different from those found in the Jewish Talmud or the rituals of ancient religions recorded on stone pillars in Babylon. If one studies more closely, one sees that it is no different from the religious rituals of Egypt, Tibet, or China. Why is there such a coincidence? Why do civilizations that are very far apart in terms of geography and time have similar rituals and prayers? Is it true that since ancient times there has been contact and communication between people of those countries?

Or are they all influenced by a common origin, by a global civilization that is beyond the understanding of today's people? Did the Taoists of the past possess transcendent knowledge through diligent practice that not many people know about today? Thanks to possessing this knowledge, they realized that on a level of consciousness higher than that of ordinary people, where there is no difference, where there is no distinction, the truth or natural laws of the universe are unchanging, no matter where or in what time.

Today, many people believe that mysticism is an Eastern tradition. Saying so means not mastering the historical elements because even in the West, mysticism also has a quite glorious past. Druids in England practiced magic in the dark caves of their land.

They left behind many monuments such as the stone pillars at Stonehenge whose purpose is not known today. They also carved geometric shapes on cliffs along the Irish coast to remind humanity of something that no one understands today. British history has recorded the wise management of the nation by Celtic leaders through glorious legends that are still mentioned by the people but few people fully understand their hidden meaning. The Semathe wizards of Gaul (present-day France) left behind a lot of documents on mathematics, physics, and cosmology that today researchers are amazed at the knowledge about the operation of the stars and the formation of the earth. In the forests of Central Europe, archaeologists have found many buried documents detailing the meetings, discussions, and exchange of knowledge of these Taoists. Many documents about the origin and evolution of mankind are very accurate, even though they were written thousands of years ago.

In short, since ancient times, there have been ancient civilizations with profound knowledge but for some reason have disappeared from the surface of the earth, leaving only a few fragments that today many scientists have deliberately ignored and paid no attention to. No one knows when people were present on this earth and what they learned and researched. Modern documents still claim that humans only appeared a few tens of thousands of years ago, but at that time lived like animals, only knowing how to gather, and then switched to hunting and farming; It was not until recently that people learned about science and became more civilized. Is this argument reasonable? This needs to be reconsidered.

The speaker paused as if to let everyone think, then continued:

- Currently, most people think that human civilization started in Mesopotamia and then spread everywhere. Many historians believe that the spread of this civilization followed the religious development of the Persians at that time, Zoroastrianism. Zoroaster, also known as Zarathustra, founded a mystical sect called the Magi, but most archaeologists disagree with historians. They believe that Zoroaster is just a Taoist who reformed and changed ancient mysticism into a scientific system.

Some other archaeologists believe that human civilization originated from Egypt and then passed into Persia, mixed with the Mesopotamian civilization at that time to form a new civilization, and then continued to spread to other countries. In short, according to this concept, there are two different civilizations, integrated through historical events and time, then affecting other places.

The question that needs to be asked is whether there are only those two civilizations or are there other civilizations. Why are there only two and not many different civilizations, originating from different places, influencing each other? What do archaeologists know about civilizations in India, China or Tibet?

What do these civilizations have to do with Mesopotamian or Egyptian civilization? It's time to reconsider whether the theory "there is only one origin, then spreads everywhere" is still accurate or not.

He reasoned:

- Most research projects on ancient civilizations today only rely on construction works, products or excavated objects to determine the value of civilization. This is a big shortcoming because not all civilizations pay attention to the construction of mausoleums. There are ancient civilizations, advanced in the spiritual realm, understanding the laws of the universe. They did not care about construction projects, did not leave behind material products, but left behind a profound foundation of wisdom, a noble spiritual tradition, through books, through oral stories, through poems with deep, hidden words. In my opinion, Indian, Tibetan and Chinese civilizations belong to this category.

Today, many scientists, historians, archaeologists, mostly Westerners, do not accept that there are many different civilizations that appeared in different times and have different understandings. They deny what comes from Asia because of the self-respecting concept of Western science. Therefore, saying that everything comes from a single place like Mesopotamia is an unreasonable, discriminatory, and denial of the truth.

He concluded:

- Through the process of studying many civilizations in the world since

East to West, I can conclude that today it cannot be said that there is only one civilization that originated from the Middle East, whether it was Mesopotamia or Egypt and then spread everywhere, while forgetting other ancient civilizations such as India, Tibet or China, or maybe there are other, more ancient civilizations, that no one has discovered or known about today.

After the presentation, I asked Andrew and Connie:

- What do you think about this presentation?

Connie said immediately:

- I think the speaker spoke well and the speech was also very valuable. As a researcher, he probably knows much more, but due to time constraints, he only said it briefly.

Andrew continued:

- It is a complex topic, difficult to explain every detail. Besides, this is just a lecture for students and museum visitors.

We had just left the lecture hall when we immediately met Professor Morris, head of the archeology department at New York University. Mr. Morris came to visit us because he knew that I owned a large company and sponsored this university every year.

Mr. Morris happily said:

- It was a surprise and a pleasure to meet you. I didn't expect you to be interested in ancient civilizations like this?

I also politely said:

- Occasionally we also go to concerts and attend valuable lectures at New York University. Today's topic is very interesting and valuable. I completely agree with the speaker's research.

Professor Morris was surprised:

- Is that so? This is a topic that still causes heated debate in the research community. Although Professor Baader is still young, he has many valuable research projects. Let me introduce him to you.

Most of the research projects of US universities are often sponsored by private companies or associations. I knew Professor Morris wanted to introduce this young professor to me because maybe my company would sponsor his research. I smiled, pulled out the business card and gave it to Professor Morris:

- Yes, please let Professor Baader know that I am very interested in this research project and if I need anything, Professor Baader can come see me.

The surprising thing was that just a few days later, Professor Baader called to make an appointment. The meeting took place at my office. After a few normal social sentences, I immediately said:

- If possible, professor, please tell me more about ancient civilizations.

I am very interested in this topic.

Professor Baader freely shared:

- I have been researching for many years now and have traveled extensively to examine ancient ruins, from Egyptian temples to Tibetan pagodas, from castles in Europe to the tombs of kings in Asia. I interacted with local people to hear about folk legends. Although many stories are mythical, some of them are also very valuable for my research.

I asked:

- According to books about world civilizations, most of the knowledge comes from Egypt, what is this story?

Professor Baader replied:

- That was a very big mistake. Egyptian civilization has its values, but Egypt is not the cradle of world civilization. Since ancient times, the Egyptians have had a very high spiritual tradition, closely associated with religion. At that time, Egypt had an ancient religion worshiping the solar god Ra. Most scholars today believe that Egyptian religion is a polytheistic religion - based on texts, documents, and relics in temples. But in my opinion, polytheistic religion only appeared after the golden age of ancient religion had declined.

I wonder:

- According to you, did Egypt have two different religions in the past?

Professor Baader explains:

- That's right, according to the documents of historian Jean Champollion (1780 - 1832), the priests of Thebes wanted to expand the power of the group and "gave birth" to many different gods to turn the ancient noble religion into a strictly organized church with forms of worship, superstition, and some black magic, using charms and magic to mesmerize people's minds.

Champollion cited that since ancient times, Egyptian religion still worshiped a single being, called the Sun Ra, because the ancient book of the holy master Thoth (known to the Greeks as Hermes) clearly recorded this. Thoth wrote that there is only one being who spread light to all living things and created life on earth. The ancient book of Thoth clearly states: "From Him, there is light, and the light shines everywhere to dispel the darkness. From there, life appears, creating all things. Without Him, all creatures cannot exist. Because no one knows His name, they temporarily took the sun as a symbol and called Him the Sun Ra."

Thoth promotes worshiping the sun as a symbol of the sublime because He is inherently invisible, formless and nameless. Thoth knew it was impossible to name such an abstract concept for the people, so he gave the name the Sun Ra, or the creator of all things. Since then, all temples, pyramids, and sphinxes were built facing the East, toward the rising sun, where the creator appeared every day.

On the stone pillar of the Karnak temple, Thoth's teachings were clearly written:

"The East is where the Sun appears, and is also the place to orient life, which always recurs endlessly like day and night. Only by returning to the East can people truly know themselves. When you know yourself, you will know everything, and find the truth to live according to the true meaning of life."

I continued to ask:

- According to your research, why did such a beautiful civilization decline?

Baader replied calmly:

- There are many reasons leading to the decline of Egyptian civilization. The first reason is that the clergy did not practice according to the principles of ancient religion. They cannot control themselves, do not know how to discipline themselves, but are lazy and dependent, only worrying about enjoyment, and then the beautiful religion loses its essence. You should know that most spiritual traditions are practiced and preserved by priests. If these people do not practice, do not obey discipline and rules, and do not know how to preserve it, it will decline. The main reason leading to the decline of ancient religion is the irresponsibility of the clergy. Because they are lazy and do not keep the precepts, most people have no spiritual knowledge or correct understanding. To compensate for this shortcoming, some began to use black magic, then the movement of using charms and magic to mesmerize people's minds spread throughout the temples, polluting the ancient religion. When the people no longer trusted the clerical leaders, when evil magic caused cultural decline and social chaos, the Pharaohs began to take power, limiting the clerics to worship and sacrifice and not being involved in other matters. That was the root cause of the power struggle between the Pharaohs and the clergy.

The second reason is the use of language. Since ancient times, the Egyptians have had a common type of writing. Most documents, documents, and transactions use this type of font. However, clergy use a special type of writing called hieroglyphs in religious documents because there are hidden, deep details that cannot be expressed in words. This is a special type of writing for initiates who have studied deeply to communicate with each other. Today, people can still find these allusions in the books The Book of Medicine and the Book of Death. Because most of the clergy turned to paganism and refused to study and research anymore, the books of ancient religions, written in hidden letters, gradually disappeared, over time no one could read them anymore.

The third reason is when the Pharaohs were influenced by paganism, using charms and magic to communicate with creatures of the underworld.

They were taught that if they knew how to embalm their bodies and practice some rituals, they would live forever and become immortal in the afterlife.

Therefore, they built great mausoleums to preserve their bodies without knowing that their bodies became a place for the effects of the underworld to manifest. Believing that humans can become immortal, building tombs became the main ambition of Egyptian kings. Over time, construction became a major industry with tens of thousands of workers and slaves specializing in tomb construction, depleting the nation's potential. To have money to build monumental tombs, the Pharaohs invaded surrounding countries, seizing resources, gold, silver and slaves. From then on, every Pharaoh waged war, defeated the surrounding countries, and made enemies everywhere.

After many dynasties and many ups and downs, Egyptian civilization gradually declined. When human resources are exhausted due to construction projects, when kings only hope to be immortal in the afterlife, when corrupt officials destroy national assets, when everyone only lives selfishly, society is in chaos, the people are miserable and miserable, and Egypt becomes easy prey for surrounding countries. For thousands of years, the Egyptian people had to live under the yoke of domination by the Nubians, Assyrians, Persians, Greeks, Romans, Arabs, Ottomans, and more recently the British and French. The consequence of this was that Egyptian culture completely disappeared, even popular writing was lost, let alone hieroglyphs. Therefore, no one knows the culture, history or inscriptions inscribed in ancient tombs or on stone pillars in temples anymore. Nowadays, most Egyptians no longer know their noble origin, glorious culture or heroic history, but they only identify with Arab culture.

I listened silently, but an indescribable sadness welled up in my heart. Professor Baader's words coincided very well with my experience of my previous life in Egypt.

Professor Baader continued:

- In 1801, Emperor Napoleon led troops to conquer Egypt.

A group of soldiers building a fortress along the banks of the Nile River found a stone stele engraved with three types of letters: hieroglyphs, popular letters and Greek letters. That was a decree from the Memphis monks promoting the merits of the fifth generation Pharaoh Ptolemy.

Because it was engraved with three different types of letters, European scholars immediately compared it and gradually traced the Egyptian hieroglyphs. Jean Champollion, a famous French scholar and historian, was instructed by Emperor Napoleon to study this set of letters to find out what was inscribed on the stone pillars. Thanks to that, he rewrote all the hieroglyphs that had been lost for thousands of years. This work has revealed the mysterious veil that has covered Egyptian civilization for thousands of years.

Champollion continued the work of translating ancient Egyptian documents, especially the books of the holy master Thoth, which were also recorded on stone stele and stone pillars. Being a cautious person, he reminded later scholars that hieroglyphs were a sacred science, people could only partially understand the common meaning, based on speculation about the alphabet. To deeply grasp mystical meanings, one must have spiritual knowledge, a transcendent knowledge that is higher than the level of ordinary knowledge. Therefore, he concluded that people should only consider alliterative translations as a speculation, the meaning of the word could not be determined its true meaning.

I continued to ask:

- I greatly admire your research on Egypt with historical evidence. In addition, do you know anything else about this civilization?

Professor Baader enthusiastically shared more:

- Since ancient times, Egypt has been considered the largest cultural center in the Near East and is the gathering place of many saints and sages. Historian Ennemoser noted that Greek sages such as Thales, Herodotus, Orphee, Parmenides, Enedoples and Pythagoras all went to Egypt to study. Who and where they learn from is unknown. Maybe they went to the temple to receive instruction from the priests as historian Herodotus wrote in his book.

But it is also possible that they went to deserted oases to study with learned Taoists - as Pythagoras told his students about the time he lived in the Egyptian desert. Who are these Taoists? No one knows and no books record it clearly, but if they were the teachers of sages like Pythagoras, Thales or Orphee, they must have been great teachers and great sages. The question is why there is no documented record. Could it be that these great men were humble and did not care about worldly fame and profit, so they refused to reveal their identities?

I wonder:

- Why did those hermits in the desert leave no trace?

Professor Baader replied:

- According to my research, since ancient times there have been disagreements between clergy about cultivation methods. Every spiritual tradition is divided into two parts: esoteric and esoteric. For Taoists or priests who practice esoteric methods, self-knowledge is the main thing. Once you are aware of yourself, of your divine origin, everything will naturally be answered.

Therefore, before trying to explain external phenomena, the laws of the universe, before accepting students or teaching anything, they turn inside to learn about themselves through methods of internal practice. Therefore, most people go to deep, deserted places to practice, not many people live in noisy, complicated temples.

For clergy who practice exoteric teachings, knowledge of natural laws is a good tool to use for certain personal purposes. Instead of turning inward, they turned outward to research and turn this knowledge into a science, using natural abilities, from which they gained magical powers. However, because of a lack of self-knowledge, they let motivations such as greed, anger, and pride sway, gradually going down the path of using black magic. Thanks to their knowledge of the hidden dynamics in nature, they can call and command the creatures of the underworld. They consider themselves noble beings, representing certain gods. Instead of guiding people, they only teach what benefits them or their faction.

Instead of helping people learn to progress, they use knowledge for selfish, greedy things, distracting people with promises to protect personal rights. Instead of helping people escape the conventions and constraints of narrow prejudices through self-knowledge, they turned natural laws into a strict law full of oppression and threats. Under their guidance, the Sun Ra is no longer the creator who gives light to dispel the dark night, but has turned into a fierce god, easily angry, ready to punish those who disobey him. That is the reason why ancient religious civilizations are gradually lost.

The true clergy could not stand the form of ideological oppression and withdrew into the desolate desert to hermit, not caring about worldly affairs.

Meanwhile, pagan priests, sorcerers, and spell users became more and more numerous. They colluded with greedy, cruel Pharaohs to create new forms of belief that worshiped the countless gods they had created, thus Egyptian religion became a polytheistic religion.

I asked further:

- Where did you base your conclusion like that?

Professor Baader replied, his voice calm:

- I rely on documents found in the tomb of Pharaoh Ramses II, including a decree stating that this king ordered the destruction of all books about natural laws of the Taoist Denarath and everything that refers to ancient religion. After Moses liberated the Jewish people, Pharaoh Ramses burned all mystical books and killed the priests who practiced the ancient religion. This is clear evidence of the dispute between esoteric and exoteric concepts.

Professor Baader paused for a moment, then continued:

- According to my research on ancient documents, the reason Judaism has some of its quintessence is thanks to the work of Queen Mother Batria, the foster mother of the prophet Moses. Queen Mother Batria is a mystical disciple who has been taught the quintessence of ancient religion. It was thanks to her education that the Jewish people had an excellent prophet and teacher like Moses. The Bible clearly states: "When he was young, Moses was trained in the profound wisdom tradition of Egypt." This verse implies that the essence of ancient religion was given to Moses. A passage in the Bible records: "When Moses received this wisdom, he covered his face with a cloth." Some modern-day archaeologists and clerics believe that he hid his face while learning these teachings. But this sentence has no meaning at all because the Bible does not say anything about covering your face when going to school. In my opinion, this verse implies that a veil of secrecy has been placed over what Moses was taught because only the esoteric essence needs to be hidden. This means that Moses learned secret teachings.

Jewish history records that Moses received mystical training in Heliopolis, a city about a few dozen miles north of today's capital Cairo. It is a city built around a very large Thai Duong temple. In the middle of this city there is a very tall stone pillar inscribed with hidden words whose meaning is still unknown today. In Jewish scriptures, Moses often mentioned this pillar as an important place that he often walked around to meditate on its significance. Later Greek sages such as Plato, Thales and Herodotus also mentioned this stone pillar in their documents. Does the stone pillar have a special meaning that the sages all mentioned? Why did ancient people build stone pillars in the middle of the street? This is a secret that no one has been able to explain. In addition to this giant stone pillar, there are also seven smaller stone pillars built around it.

History records that after conquering Egypt, Emperor Napoleon himself came to see this stone pillar. He often stood in front of the jelly pillars for a long time as if thinking about something. Finally, he ordered a small stone pillar to be removed and erected in the middle of Paris. Many people believe that Napoleon saw it as a trophy of his conquest of Egypt. However, I didn't think so, but guessed that perhaps Emperor Napoleon knew some of the secret of the pillar heather plants, so he brought them back and placed them in Paris. Although it has stood in the middle of Paris for a long time, archaeologists and linguists still do not know what the words on this stone pillar mean.

When they occupied Egypt, the British also removed a stone pillar and brought it to London to set up next to the banks of the Thames River. Both of these stone pillars are engraved with hidden words, but until now no one understands what they refer to. Currently, archaeologists are still debating the origin and purpose of these stone pillars, but have not been able to come to any conclusion. Just as until now, no one knows what purpose the pyramids were built for.

I asked further:

- So what do you think these lines mean?

Professor Baader smiled and replied:

- In my opinion, these hidden words are the mystical key that only highly practiced disciples, who have opened the eye of the path, can understand. If you keep translating every sentence and every word literally and then making false guesses, becoming naive sayings, it's useless. Symbolic, figurative meanings and prophecies are not simple things that a normal person can understand. Therefore, further and deeper research is needed.

I nodded in agreement because in my heart I also knew that there were even more ancient civilizations, but these were things that could not be said. I continued asking:

- So how do you plan to continue your research?

Professor Baader shared:

- Although some of today's scientific knowledge comes more or less from ancient Jews, few people ask where did the Jews learn it from? If the Jews learned from Egypt, where did the Egyptians learn these things? Up to now, most research documents on ancient civilizations have stopped at Egypt or Mesopotamia because those are the civilizations considered the most ancient. However, if we remove narrow biases, we have recently found more ancient documents in India, Tibet and China. Therefore, I think it is time for researchers and archaeologists to go to these civilizations to learn more.

- So you think that Indian and Chinese civilizations are older than

Egypt?

- If based only on the relics dug up there, Eastern civilizations like India and China only began about four thousand years BC with vague anecdotes that we today call legends. Therefore, archaeologists place Chinese civilization actually starting around three thousand years BC, that is, after the Egyptian and Mesopotamian civilizations. However, due to the lack of serious research projects, perhaps the lands around India, China or Tibet still hide certain civilizational relics that few people know about.

In 1924, archaeologists found an ancient city in the Northeast of India (Mohenjo Daro) with hundreds of houses built of very solid soil. Some houses are also built with two floors. Each house has its own bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and toilet with a water system from the river into the house and sewer pipes to other places. These houses are all decorated according to specific plans, every few dozen houses have a square, which archaeologists believe is a market place or a public meeting place. Dating methods confirm that this civilization appeared between ten thousand and fifteen thousand years BC, meaning it existed before the Egyptian and Mesopotamian civilizations. No one knows anything about this civilization or the people who lived there, and this research is still ongoing. If we look at the time, at this time almost everyone in Europe was still living in the Stone Age, not knowing how to build houses, only knowing how to gather or hunt. How should we conclude? Is it true that since ancient times, there have been civilizations that existed in many parts of the world that for some reason have mysteriously disappeared?

Professor Baader humorously said:

- If for some reason most people in this civilized era disappear from the face of the earth, in a few hundred years, people will dig up rudimentary tools of primitive tribes in Africa, what will they think? Is it true that some people will conclude that people in the twentieth century only know how to live barbarically and eat only their hair?

In the face of new evidence that has just been discovered, we need to ask whether since ancient times, many places on the surface of the earth, especially in the East, have had highly developed civilizations compared to the West. Is it true that when Westerners were still living savagely in the mountains and deep forests, Eastern people knew how to live in groups, built cities, developed agriculture, handicrafts, and especially had a very high spiritual life? Is it true that when Westerners were busy finding a livelihood, Easterners knew how to think about deeper, broader things and had answers to their questions?

For example, India is a special country with strange, complex, and difficult to describe religious traditions. Recently, archaeologists have found many ancient documents written from seven thousand years BC whose origins the wisest ancient linguists have yet to trace. No one has understood what these strange words mean. It is even more ancient than Sanskrit, so it must come from some ancient civilization that no one knows about. If the Egyptian or Jewish Magi carefully preserved their esoteric teachings, the Indians kept it even more carefully. Instead of spreading to a select few followers like in Egypt or the Jews, Indian mysticism was only spread in special cases, for the common good.

Since ancient times, Indians have possessed a treasure of scientific knowledge covering many fields, from astronomy to geography, from mathematics to metaphysics. Yoga that people know today is just a small chapter in a very thick book that records ancient knowledge that has now been lost.

Ancient documents record that India once had a golden age, an era when people knew how to live according to the laws of nature. After that, this country went into a period of decline due to not knowing how to control desires, especially male and female sexuality, and led to incest. To resolve this social disorder, the leaders met and decided to teach a small part of the book recording ancient knowledge. That is the chapter of Yuj which today is called Yoga. This is just a part that teaches methods of cultivating the body and mind to coordinate body and mind, developing human intellectual abilities. If this is true, then that set of books, the sacred cultural treasure of ancient India, must be the product of an extremely sublime culture. Of course, nowadays no one understands anything about that civilization anymore.

Professor Baader explained:

- You also know that every nation has legends about

their origins, describing the terrain, mountains, rivers and how their ancestors built their culture. Many people think that it is just a legend that was exaggerated by later people so it has no historical value, but maybe it also hides something that we don't know yet. In my opinion, legends are not just imagination, although the details are not accurate, they always contain hidden meanings that future generations must consider to understand the work of their predecessors. A nation cannot stand for a long time in history without heroes fighting to protect their country. A country cannot exist without a distinct culture of excellence, different from the cultures of surrounding countries. Otherwise, they will be assimilated. If we only rely on scientific reasoning and then refute myths, it would be a pity.

I wonder:

- Why do you focus on such legends?

Professor Baader continued to share:

- As you know, Homer's epic Iliad is a legend about the battle between Lord Agamemnon and Troy to steal back a beautiful woman named Helen. The Trojan War highlighted heroes such as Hector, Achilles, Ulysses... as well as the intervention of Greek gods in human life. For many years, everyone has considered it to be the rich imagination of the poet Homer. Today, people have found the ruins of Troy and many documents related to this battle. Therefore, everyone recognizes that this "legend" is a historical event, with real details and characters, but Homer only added a few details to this immortal epic.

As you know, since ancient times, Greece has had a highly developed civilization. Its philosophers, historians and scholars taught science, philosophy, mathematics and astrology, the influence of which still exists today. It was Greek civilization that laid the foundation for current European civilization. Greek history is full of myths and poems that glorify founding heroes and courageous soldiers willing to sacrifice to protect their homeland. No other culture has so many heroes. One historian compiled a list of ancient Greek heroes, whether real or legendary, and put the number at more than five thousand. Why so much?

If you consider the historical context at that time, you can see that Persia was a very strong expanding power, they invaded and occupied most of the countries around the region, then assimilated other races such as Metani, Hittite, Assyria, Egypt, and threatened Greece.

Persia controlled the seas around Greece, occupying islands such as Crete, Eubeas, Rhodes, Sacconi and Santorini to control and master important trade routes. The Persians believe that the Mediterranean belongs to their territory and they intend to control all sea routes here.

There have been many battles between these two countries. Persia repeatedly invaded Greece, but thanks to the heroic spirit of the people of this country, Greece still maintained its independence. Then, under the command of Alexander the Great, the Greeks not only conquered Persia but also controlled more than half of the world.

Historians only knew how to praise the heroic victory of Greece without paying attention to an extremely important detail. According to ancient documents, at that time Persia's troops, weapons and warships were much more advanced than Greece's. In land battles, Persia had three times more soldiers than Greece, but why did Persia lose miserably, one battle after another, and finally had to submit to Greece? Do you know why?

I thought, then shook my head:

- I don't know, did the Greeks have bold plans or effective strategies?

Professor Baader laughed:

- That's not true. Both countries have powerful armies and talented generals. According to historical documents, the patriotic spirit of the Greeks at that time was very high. Why? Because their culture focuses on patriotism and raising the morale of the entire people. According to documents, at that time there was not a single Greek soldier who did not memorize Homer's poems that exalted heroes. In my opinion, it is the poems and songs praising the indomitable and courageous spirit of heroes such as Hercules, Achilles, Agamemnon, Hector, Ulysses... that aroused the heroic fighting spirit of the Greeks, and that was an important cause in the fight to protect the country. It is not just having many soldiers and good weapons that can win a battle. It is the spirit of heroism, courage, determination, and fearlessness that is the main reason that brought victory to the Greek army and brought the country to a powerful position shortly after Alexander the Great came to power.

***

I recalled all my past life experiences and interesting stories with Mr. Kris and Professor Baader, and I realized a truth. Thus, through many studies, experiments, practical experiences and history, we have proven what many generations of people, many religions and many genius philosophers have argued: "Not only does human life have reincarnation and rebirth, but empires, dynasties, and human civilizations of this planet also have cycles of reincarnation - according to a rule, nothing is eternal."

PART SEVEN

FORMATION - STATION AND DECAY - DESTRUCTION

THE UNIVERSE CIRCLE

I have been practicing the meditation method for more than a month and feel comfortable and at ease, my breathing gradually becomes lighter than before. I sat down on the floor in the lotus position. At first my legs and back hurt a bit, but I remembered Mr. Kris's advice, just concentrate on breathing lightly, keeping my mind calm. I knew the pain was because my body was not used to it. If I kept turning around to relieve the pain, I would not be able to control my body, so I maintained my posture and sat still to endure. Not long after, the pain gradually disappeared. From then on, I realized that the feeling of pain originates from within the mind, and if I keep my mind calm, the pain cannot affect me anymore.

Seeing me sitting cross-legged, Angie was surprised and asked:

- Do you also practice meditation now?

I don't want to explain too much, so I'll just say it briefly:

- Let's practice to relax my mind a bit, but recently my work has been too stressful.

Hearing that, Angie said:

- If you need to rest, why don't we go to Colorado to rest for a few days?

I agreed, so that weekend, we were at the vacation home. After resting for a few days, I visited Mr. Kris and told him about practicing the meditation method he had advised me.

Mr. Kris happily said:

- If you can sit firmly and keep your mind calm, you will have overcome the initial difficult period. Now, you need to focus on eliminating unnecessary thoughts and not letting them run wild anymore. This stage will take more time because your past thinking habits will stir up your mind. Even though he sat still, his mind would generate countless thoughts, one after another. Therefore, you must know how to observe them but not let them affect you.

Just let them come and go naturally, you will see how thoughts emerge, function, then disappear or sink. You have to be calm, not interfere, keep your breath steady, then over time there will be samadhi. Concentration comes from patience. Even if your body is in pain, still maintain your posture.

Even if your mind generates these thoughts, still maintain your breathing and not let them affect you. After practicing for a while, you will improve. The important thing at this time is to continue to adhere to the moment, without change. This is a necessary habit to keep because if you sit hard for a few days and then rest for a few days, it will be difficult to go far.

I thank Mr. Kris for this simple, easy-to-understand instruction. Then, Mr. Kris explained further:

- In today's times, there are many things that distract people's minds, so it is very difficult to practice according to the same methods as the ancients did. In the world of technology, human psychology has been influenced and influenced by too many things. Therefore, we must start from the basic steps, form habits, and develop concentration to be able to deal with the current situation. Once you have concentration, then you can go deeper. Therefore, practice should not be hasty or rash.

I told Mr. Kris about Professor Baader's research.

Mr. Kris said, looking interested:

- Obviously archaeological research can discover more data

about ancient civilizations and human origins.

Seeing that Mr. Kris also seemed to understand these things, I asked further:

- Can we know the origin of humans or the future of humanity?

Mr. Kris laughed:

- Question “Where do people come from and where will they go?” is a question that has existed since ancient times. There have been many theories proposed to answer this question, but no theory has been able to answer it satisfactorily. Each era tries to answer it according to the concepts and value foundations prevailing at that time. Obviously, when society changes, science advances, and the value base changes, concepts and arguments also change. However, currently there is no theory that has long-term value and can withstand the test of time.

Mr. Kris explained further:

- Many centuries ago, people believed that there was a Creator who created all things, including humans. However, according to the theory of the scientific age, humans originated from single-celled organisms, gradually transformed into more complex creatures such as fish, reptiles, mammals, then evolved into primates, and finally became humans. Biologist Charles Darwin's Theory of Evolution became the foundation of experimental science, overthrowing the previous theory of Chemistry. In other words, science has provided an argument to abolish belief in the Creator. In the future, perhaps there will be another concept that will overthrow Darwin's Theory of Evolution. In short, depending on people's understanding in each era, the concept of human origin also changes accordingly.

- If so, how did the ancients conceive of human origin

?

- Since ancient times, sages have known how to observe nature, so their perspective is not based on abstract theories or scientific data like today. There is an ancient Jewish book Siphra Dzeniouta, considered the oldest book, which mentions the other document with the caption “Quoted from the ancient books of the ancestors”. If so, then this document must have been written very long ago because Jewish scholars, famous for being careful and meticulous, could not trace its origin. This document includes mathematical equations that represent changes in the universe with spirals and formulas that researchers today still struggle to explain because it is so complicated.

According to this document, everything in the world changes in a spiral, not in a straight line from low to high, as scientists today advocate. Each round is a cycle consisting of four stages: Creation, Persistence, Destruction, and Destruction before moving on to another cycle. The concept of cycles was actually mentioned by Indians and Chinese in their books a long time ago, but they did not go into detail and use mathematical equations like those ancient documents.

According to this document, each cycle has civilizations that appear, develop, decline, and then disappear, giving way to other civilizations in the next cycle. Therefore, we can speculate that perhaps in the past, there were civilizations of human races with different bodies than us, with different understanding than us, were present on this earth, and after developing, declined and disappeared when their cycle entered the stage of Degeneration and Destruction.

Nowadays, of course no one believes that there were ancient human races, different from our species, or ancient civilizations with knowledge different from ours. More and more discoveries are being made about human origins. When geologists found rudimentary stone tools, they concluded that if we went further back than the Stone Age, humanity at that time would just be barbarians, no different from animals. Therefore, when Charles Darwin hypothesized that humans started from apes and then evolved into humans, this concept was immediately accepted by scientists in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, that our civilization today is the result of evolution from low to high, from barbarism to civilization, that today we are at the pinnacle through the discoveries and inventions of experimental science.

I laughed:

- However, it is hard to believe that since ancient times there have been human races different from us on this earth.

Mr. Kris leisurely continued:

- In the past, there was a popular legend among Greek scholars recorded by the philosopher Plato in Phaedrus: "Humans were, and will become, winged creatures, living in heaven with the gods. In fact, they were originally gods, because they lost their wings and had to live on earth as humans. When they find their wings again, they will fly back to their homeland. them."

I asked in surprise:

- Did the philosopher Plato write like that? I've never read Phaedrus, but maybe it's just a metaphor, referring to some issue?

Mr. Kris nodded in agreement:

- Of course, there is no evidence that humans in the past had wings and flew in space. Not long ago, archaeologists found in a pyramid in South America an ancient document called Popol Vuh, which recorded the origin of humanity as follows:

“In the past, people did not have a clear form like today, but were only light entities, living in a world close to the spirits. They had the ability to reason deeply and communicate with each other through thoughts. These entities possessed an almost infinite vision, able to see everything. Their world was all are invisible species, good and bad, high and low.

Living in a noble world, seeing other worlds, some people come to this world curiously and become polluted

When their bodies are attached to heavy and impure material elements, they cannot return to the light world and are forced to stay here. To live in this impure world, they must create material 'suits' to shield and protect their sensitive senses. This material 'clothing' gave them a form, helping them adapt to their new life. Because it is composed of material elements, it hinders their senses, making them senses no longer as sharp. Gradually, this 'clothes' becomes a barrier separating them from that noble world. Because they could no longer communicate with each other through thought, they had to create language to express their thoughts. Of course language is only a limited intermediate means, it cannot express all true understanding. Over time, their knowledge gradually became limited by the language they used. When the quintessence of understanding is lost, man becomes depraved, noble thoughts are replaced by lowly thoughts, the superior senses of the soul are replaced by the low senses of the physical body. In the end, their descendants only know how to live passively, no longer knowing anything about their divine origin or transcendent abilities in the past. However, a very few remember a little about the origin through oral stories or possess some special knowledge by controlling the body and cultivating the spirit, so they can communicate with the divine realm, thus seeing future events. They were the prophets, or magicians of old.”

- Hearing you explain in such detail, I think perhaps you also believe that everything changes according to the concept of cycles?

Mr. Kris looked at me attentively, then calmly answered:

- If explained according to current scientific theory, that humans originate from low-level species, evolve into humans, go from low to high, in a straight line and continue to change forever, then this cyclical concept cannot be accepted. But if explained according to the ancient concept of spirals, each cycle is a different cycle, continuing continuously, through four stages of Creation - Persistence - Degeneration - Destruction, then this is very reasonable and acceptable.

I asked:

- But if there were such civilizations, why did they all disappear so quickly?

Mr. Kris patiently answered:

- According to physics, if we throw an object into the air, the force of the throw must be strong at first, but gradually reduces as it rises, then changes direction to fall with the opposite force, slowly at first, then increases strongly. Likewise, the stages of Construction and Abstinence take a lot of effort, but when entering the stages of Destruction and Destruction, it usually happens very quickly. Every civilization takes a long time to build, but when it declines, this event happens extremely quickly.

For example, humans have gone through many centuries to have the current civilization, but what if there was a great war, with atomic weapons destroying everything, all living things would die? If all that belongs to current civilization is destroyed, then in the next period, who will know anything about this era?

Mr. Kris looked at me meaningfully, then said:

- Similarly, if a major earthquake occurred around the world, burying all continents into the ocean, there would be no relics left. This happened to Atlantis, don't you remember?

I asked further:
